    theme: darkly
    self-contained: true
    include-before-body:
      text: |
        <nav class='sk-nav'><strong>Standings</strong><a href='https://ejperez2.github.io/Daily-Skins-Matchups/'>Daily Matchups</a><button id='refresh-btn' class='sk-btn' type='button' style='display:none;'>Refresh now</button><span id='refresh-msg' style='font-size:13px; opacity:0.85;'></span><span class='sk-who' hidden>I'm <span class='sk-seg' id='sk-me'></span></span></nav>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <footer class='sk-footer'>Past seasons &middot; 2025-26: <a href='https://ejperez2.github.io/skins-standings/2025-26/'>Standings</a> &middot; <a href='https://ejperez2.github.io/Daily-Skins-Matchups/2025-26/'>Matchups</a></footer>
    grid:
      body-width: 800px
editor: visual
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Mobile-first layout shared with Daily Matchups (same tokens, nav and "I'm" picker) */
:root {
  --sk-surface: #2b2b2b; --sk-line: #444; --sk-muted: #aaa; --sk-accent: #f2a541; --sk-mine: #3a3121; --sk-bar: #444;
  --sk-good: #6fd497; --sk-good-bg: #173726; --sk-bad: #ff8a92; --sk-bad-bg: #3d1d21;

.sk-progress { margin: 10px 0 4px 0; }

@media (max-width: 480px) {

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .sk-chev { transition: none; } }
</style>
<script>
// Refresh: asks the Cloudflare Worker (which holds the GitHub token) to start an update, same as Daily Matchups.
// Until the Worker lists this page it answers "Unknown page"; then fall back to a GitHub token saved in this
// browser (its own key, since Daily Matchups clears the old shared "skinsRefreshToken").
(function () {
  var PROXY = "https://skins-refresh.ejperez2.workers.dev/?repo=skins-standings";
  var DISPATCH = "https://api.github.com/repos/ejperez2/skins-standings/actions/workflows/publish.yml/dispatches";
  var KEY = "skinsStandingsToken";
  var btn = document.getElementById("refresh-btn"), msg = document.getElementById("refresh-msg");
  if (!btn) return;
  function get() { try { return localStorage.getItem(KEY); } catch (e) { return null; } }
  function set(v) { try { v ? localStorage.setItem(KEY, v) : localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) {} }
  if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("admin") === "reset") { set(null); msg.textContent = "Saved token removed."; }
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  function done() { setTimeout(function () { btn.disabled = false; }, 30000); }
  function withToken() {
    var token = get();
    if (!token) {
      token = (prompt("This page isn't set up in the refresh proxy yet. Paste a GitHub token (saved only in this browser):") || "").trim();
      if (!token) { msg.textContent = ""; btn.disabled = false; return; }
      set(token);
    }
    fetch(DISPATCH, { method: "POST", headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ ref: "main" }) })
      .then(function (r) {
        if (r.status === 204) msg.textContent = "Refresh started - reload in about 4 minutes.";
        else if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403 || r.status === 404) { set(null); msg.textContent = "Token rejected (" + r.status + ") - tap again to enter a new one."; btn.disabled = false; return; }
        else msg.textContent = "GitHub error " + r.status + ".";
        done();
      })
      .catch(function () { msg.textContent = "Network error - try again."; btn.disabled = false; });
  }
  btn.onclick = function () {
    btn.disabled = true; msg.textContent = "Starting...";
    fetch(PROXY, { method: "POST" })
      .then(function (r) { return r.json().catch(function () { return { msg: "Error " + r.status + "." }; }); })
      .then(function (d) { if (d.msg === "Unknown page") return withToken(); msg.textContent = d.msg || "Done."; done(); })
      .catch(function () { msg.textContent = "Network error - try again."; btn.disabled = false; });
  };
})();
</script>
```

```{r timestamp, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
ts <- format(Sys.time(), "%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p %Z", tz = "America/Chicago")
cat(sprintf("<p class='sk-meta'><strong>Last updated:</strong> %s</p>", ts))
```

```{r main-processing, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# This single code chunk handles EVERYTHING: package installation, scraping, processing, and table creation.
# cache=FALSE ensures the data is re-scraped every single time the document is rendered.

# --- Step 1: Install and Load All Necessary Libraries ---
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(httr, jsonlite, rvest, dplyr, tidyr, knitr, kableExtra, tibble, stringr, ggplot2, scales) 
# --- Step 2: Scrape and Process All Data Sources ---

# A: League configuration (2026-27: 3 players x 10 teams each)
PLAYERS <- c("Eristeo", "Brian", "Adam")
TEAMS_PER_PLAYER <- 30 / length(PLAYERS)
SEASON_START <- as.Date("2026-10-20")  # Opening night
# Colorblind-friendly palette (Paul Tol's vibrant hues, lightened to read on the dark page;
# checked for lightness, color-blind separation and contrast against the #2b2b2b card surface)
colorblind_colors <- c(
  "Eristeo" = "#3E97D6",   # Blue
  "Brian" = "#E26A54",     # Red
  "Adam" = "#22A794"       # Teal
)

# Weighted average weights (early-season; the Projection Accuracy section suggests updates)
# Oct-Nov blend chosen from 2025-26 data (see README); sources that are missing are re-weighted away,
# so before CBS publishes this is Vegas 50 / TR 25 / ESPN 25
WEIGHTS <- c(vegas = 0.40, tr = 0.20, espn = 0.20, cbs = 0.20)

# Create Draft Data Frame FIRST (needed for W/L picks)
# DRAFTED: Sunday, October 18, 2026 (10-round snake; order Adam, Brian, Eristeo).
# If draft_data is ever incomplete, the page renders in pre-draft mode (draft board only).
draft_data <- tribble(
  ~team, ~player, ~abbr, ~skins_pick, ~draft_pick,
  "Atlanta Hawks",          "Brian",       "ATL", "W", 26L,
  "Boston Celtics",         "Adam",        "BOS", "W", 7L,
  "Brooklyn Nets",          "Eristeo",     "BKN", "L", 4L,
  "Charlotte Hornets",      "Eristeo",     "CHA", "L", 28L,
  "Chicago Bulls",          "Eristeo",     "CHI", "L", 10L,
  "Cleveland Cavaliers",    "Eristeo",     "CLE", "W", 21L,
  "Dallas Mavericks",       "Brian",       "DAL", "L", 14L,
  "Denver Nuggets",         "Adam",        "DEN", "W", 6L,
  "Detroit Pistons",        "Eristeo",     "DET", "W", 16L,
  "Golden State Warriors",  "Brian",       "GSW", "L", 23L,
  "Houston Rockets",        "Adam",        "HOU", "W", 13L,
  "Indiana Pacers",         "Brian",       "IND", "W", 17L,
  "Los Angeles Clippers",   "Brian",       "LAC", "L", 5L,
  "Los Angeles Lakers",     "Eristeo",     "LAL", "W", 22L,
  "Memphis Grizzlies",      "Eristeo",     "MEM", "L", 15L,
  "Miami Heat",             "Adam",        "MIA", "W", 24L,
  "Milwaukee Bucks",        "Brian",       "MIL", "L", 8L,
  "Minnesota Timberwolves", "Adam",        "MIN", "W", 18L,
  "New Orleans Pelicans",   "Eristeo",     "NOP", "L", 9L,
  "New York Knicks",        "Brian",       "NYK", "W", 11L,
  "Oklahoma City Thunder",  "Adam",        "OKC", "W", 1L,
  "Orlando Magic",          "Brian",       "ORL", "L", 29L,
  "Philadelphia 76ers",     "Adam",        "PHI", "W", 12L,
  "Phoenix Suns",           "Adam",        "PHX", "L", 25L,
  "Portland Trail Blazers", "Adam",        "POR", "L", 30L,
  "Sacramento Kings",       "Eristeo",     "SAC", "L", 3L,
  "San Antonio Spurs",      "Brian",       "SAS", "W", 2L,
  "Toronto Raptors",        "Adam",        "TOR", "W", 19L,
  "Utah Jazz",              "Eristeo",     "UTA", "L", 27L,
  "Washington Wizards",     "Brian",       "WAS", "L", 20L
)

draft_complete <- all(!is.na(draft_data$player) & draft_data$skins_pick %in% c("W", "L"))

unknown_players <- setdiff(na.omit(draft_data$player), PLAYERS)
if (length(unknown_players) > 0) {
  stop("draft_data has players not in PLAYERS: ", paste(unknown_players, collapse = ", "))
}
if (draft_complete && any(table(factor(draft_data$player, levels = PLAYERS)) != TEAMS_PER_PLAYER)) {
  warning("Each player should have ", TEAMS_PER_PLAYER, " teams: ",
          paste(names(table(draft_data$player)), table(draft_data$player), sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
}

# CRITICAL: Create immutable reference table for W/L picks that can NEVER be overwritten
# This prevents any vestigial code from inferring picks based on projections
HARDCODED_PICKS <- draft_data %>% 
  select(team, skins_pick_hardcoded = skins_pick) %>%
  mutate(source = "DRAFT - DO NOT MODIFY")

# Store season completion for later display
season_total_games <- 0
season_completion_pct <- 0

# B: Get current NBA standings from ESPN. ESPN's CDN has served GitHub's runners a stale standings page (0-0
# records hours after games ended, with no error), so we read both ESPN's JSON standings feed and the HTML page
# and keep whichever has more games played - a stale copy can only be missing games.
espn_feed <- tryCatch({
  feed <- jsonlite::fromJSON("https://site.api.espn.com/apis/v2/sports/basketball/nba/standings?seasontype=2",
                             simplifyVector = FALSE)
  bind_rows(lapply(feed$children, function(conf) bind_rows(lapply(conf$standings$entries, function(e) {
    st <- setNames(lapply(e$stats, function(x) x$value), vapply(e$stats, function(x) x$name, ""))
    tibble(team = e$team$displayName, actual_wins = as.numeric(st$wins), actual_losses = as.numeric(st$losses))
  })))) %>%
    mutate(team = if_else(team == "LA Clippers", "Los Angeles Clippers", team))
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("ESPN standings feed failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n", file = stderr())  # visible in Actions log
  NULL
})

espn_page <- tryCatch({
  espn_url <- "https://www.espn.com/nba/standings/_/seasontype/2"  # regular season only (no preseason records)
  espn_html <- read_html(espn_url)
  all_tables <- espn_html %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)
  
  # ESPN has 4 tables: 1=East teams, 2=East stats, 3=West teams, 4=West stats
  if(length(all_tables) >= 4) {
    # East Conference
    east_standings <- tibble(
      team_raw = all_tables[[1]][[1]],
      W = all_tables[[2]]$W,
      L = all_tables[[2]]$L
    )
    
    # West Conference
    west_standings <- tibble(
      team_raw = all_tables[[3]][[1]],
      W = all_tables[[4]]$W,
      L = all_tables[[4]]$L
    )
    
    # Combine and clean
    bind_rows(east_standings, west_standings) %>%
      mutate(
        team_clean = str_replace(team_raw, "^[A-Z]{2,4}(?=[A-Z][a-z])", ""),
        team_clean = trimws(team_clean),
        team = case_when(
          grepl("LACLA Clippers", team_raw) ~ "Los Angeles Clippers",
          grepl("Clippers", team_clean) ~ "Los Angeles Clippers",
          grepl("Lakers", team_clean) ~ "Los Angeles Lakers",
          grepl("Atlanta", team_clean) ~ "Atlanta Hawks",
          grepl("Boston", team_clean) ~ "Boston Celtics",
          grepl("Brooklyn", team_clean) ~ "Brooklyn Nets",
          grepl("Charlotte", team_clean) ~ "Charlotte Hornets",
          grepl("Chicago", team_clean) ~ "Chicago Bulls",
          grepl("Cleveland", team_clean) ~ "Cleveland Cavaliers",
          grepl("Dallas", team_clean) ~ "Dallas Mavericks",
          grepl("Denver", team_clean) ~ "Denver Nuggets",
          grepl("Detroit", team_clean) ~ "Detroit Pistons",
          grepl("Golden State", team_clean) ~ "Golden State Warriors",
          grepl("Houston", team_clean) ~ "Houston Rockets",
          grepl("Indiana", team_clean) ~ "Indiana Pacers",
          grepl("Memphis", team_clean) ~ "Memphis Grizzlies",
          grepl("Miami", team_clean) ~ "Miami Heat",
          grepl("Milwaukee", team_clean) ~ "Milwaukee Bucks",
          grepl("Minnesota", team_clean) ~ "Minnesota Timberwolves",
          grepl("New Orleans", team_clean) ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
          grepl("New York", team_clean) ~ "New York Knicks",
          grepl("Oklahoma City", team_clean) ~ "Oklahoma City Thunder",
          grepl("Orlando", team_clean) ~ "Orlando Magic",
          grepl("Philadelphia", team_clean) ~ "Philadelphia 76ers",
          grepl("Phoenix", team_clean) ~ "Phoenix Suns",
          grepl("Portland", team_clean) ~ "Portland Trail Blazers",
          grepl("Sacramento", team_clean) ~ "Sacramento Kings",
          grepl("San Antonio", team_clean) ~ "San Antonio Spurs",
          grepl("Toronto", team_clean) ~ "Toronto Raptors",
          grepl("Utah", team_clean) ~ "Utah Jazz",
          grepl("Washington", team_clean) ~ "Washington Wizards",
          TRUE ~ team_clean
        ),
        actual_wins = as.numeric(W),
        actual_losses = as.numeric(L)
      ) %>%
      select(team, actual_wins, actual_losses)
  } else {
    stop("Not enough tables found on ESPN standings page")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("ESPN standings page failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n", file = stderr())
  NULL
})

standings_games <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) != 30 || anyNA(x$actual_wins)) -1 else sum(x$actual_wins + x$actual_losses)
cat(sprintf("ESPN standings: feed %s team-games, page %s team-games (-1 = unavailable)\n",
            standings_games(espn_feed), standings_games(espn_page)), file = stderr())
nba_standings <- if (max(standings_games(espn_feed), standings_games(espn_page)) >= 0) {
  if (standings_games(espn_feed) >= standings_games(espn_page)) espn_feed else espn_page
} else {
  cat("ESPN standings unavailable from both sources - showing 0-0 records\n", file = stderr())
  tibble(
    team = c("Atlanta Hawks", "Boston Celtics", "Brooklyn Nets", "Charlotte Hornets",
             "Chicago Bulls", "Cleveland Cavaliers", "Dallas Mavericks", "Denver Nuggets",
             "Detroit Pistons", "Golden State Warriors", "Houston Rockets", "Indiana Pacers",
             "Los Angeles Clippers", "Los Angeles Lakers", "Memphis Grizzlies", "Miami Heat",
             "Milwaukee Bucks", "Minnesota Timberwolves", "New Orleans Pelicans", "New York Knicks",
             "Oklahoma City Thunder", "Orlando Magic", "Philadelphia 76ers", "Phoenix Suns",
             "Portland Trail Blazers", "Sacramento Kings", "San Antonio Spurs", "Toronto Raptors",
             "Utah Jazz", "Washington Wizards"),
    actual_wins = 0,
    actual_losses = 0
  )
}

# Calculate season completion percentage
season_total_games <- sum(nba_standings$actual_wins + nba_standings$actual_losses, na.rm = TRUE)
season_completion_pct <- (season_total_games / 2460) * 100

# Projection sources are optional: if a site fails (blocked, empty page, layout change) we
# log it to the Actions log and use an empty table for that source instead of failing the render.
safe_scrape <- function(source_name, expr, empty) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
    message(source_name, " scraping failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    cat(source_name, "scraping failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n", file = stderr())  # visible in Actions log
    empty
  })
}

# B: Scrape Rotowire (Vegas Odds)
url_vegas <- "https://www.rotowire.com/betting/nba/tables/team-futures.php?future=Win%20Totals"
df_vegas <- safe_scrape("Vegas", {
  resp_vegas <- GET(url_vegas, add_headers(`User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0"))
  raw_json <- content(resp_vegas, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  out <- fromJSON(raw_json, flatten = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()
  if (!"name" %in% names(out)) stop("no team names in response")
  out
}, empty = tibble(name = character()))

# Vegas consensus: every sportsbook in Rotowire's feed (any "<book>_line" column), so books that are
# added, renamed or go silent never break the page. Each book's line is nudged 0.5 win toward the side
# its odds favor, then the books available for a team are averaged.
american_to_prob <- function(odds) case_when(odds < 0 ~ -odds / (-odds + 100), odds > 0 ~ 100 / (odds + 100), TRUE ~ NA_real_)
book_col <- function(df, col) if (col %in% names(df)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[col]])) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))

vegas_books <- setdiff(sub("_line$", "", grep("_line$", names(df_vegas), value = TRUE)), "best")  # best_line repeats one book
vegas_lines <- bind_rows(lapply(vegas_books, function(bk) {
  line_v <- book_col(df_vegas, paste0(bk, "_line"))
  over_v <- book_col(df_vegas, paste0(bk, "_odds"))
  under_v <- book_col(df_vegas, paste0(bk, "_odds_under"))
  tibble(team = df_vegas$name, book = bk, line = line_v, over = over_v, under = under_v)
}))
if (nrow(vegas_lines) == 0) vegas_lines <- tibble(team = character(), book = character(), line = numeric(), over = numeric(), under = numeric())

# C: Action Network's consensus win totals - a second feed, since Rotowire drops teams whenever its books
# pull a market (Oct 23, 2026: 15 of 30 teams). The market id changes each season, so look it up by name.
an_base <- "https://api.actionnetwork.com/web/v1/leagues/4/futures"
an_get <- function(url) fromJSON(content(GET(url, add_headers(`User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0")), as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
an_lines <- safe_scrape("Action Network", {
  avail <- an_get(paste0(an_base, "/available"))$futures
  an_type <- avail$type[grepl("Regular Season - Total Wins", avail$name, fixed = TRUE)][1]
  if (is.na(an_type)) stop("no win totals market listed")
  an <- an_get(paste0(an_base, "/", an_type))
  if (!15 %in% an$books$book_id) stop("no consensus line")
  as_tibble(an$books$odds[[which(an$books$book_id == 15)]]) %>%   # book 15 = Action Network consensus
    filter(option_type_id %in% c(72, 73)) %>%                      # 72 = over, 73 = under
    group_by(team_id) %>%
    summarise(line = mean(value), over = money[option_type_id == 72][1], under = money[option_type_id == 73][1], .groups = "drop") %>%
    inner_join(as_tibble(an$teams) %>% select(team_id = id, team = full_name), by = "team_id") %>%
    transmute(team, book = "actionnetwork", line, over, under)
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), book = character(), line = numeric(), over = numeric(), under = numeric()))
vegas_lines <- bind_rows(vegas_lines, an_lines)

vegas_lines <- vegas_lines %>%
  mutate(
    # Rotowire stores some books' lines divided by 1,000 (e.g. BetRivers 0.0435 = 43.5 wins)
    line = if_else(!is.na(line) & line > 0.004 & line < 0.078, line * 1000, line),
    # Books show 0 / junk when they have no line - keep only plausible win totals
    line = if_else(!is.na(line) & line >= 10 & line <= 72, line, NA_real_),
    p_over = american_to_prob(over),
    p_under = american_to_prob(under),
    shift = case_when(is.na(p_over) | is.na(p_under) ~ 0,
                      p_over > p_under ~ 0.5,     # over is favored -> true number a bit higher
                      p_under > p_over ~ -0.5,
                      TRUE ~ 0),
    adj_line = line + shift
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(adj_line))

# Store as projected WINS - we'll apply draft picks later. Each feed counts once: Rotowire's books are
# averaged first, then averaged with Action Network's consensus (either feed alone if the other lacks the team).
df_skins <- vegas_lines %>%
  mutate(feed = if_else(book == "actionnetwork", "actionnetwork", "rotowire")) %>%
  group_by(team, feed) %>%
  summarise(feed_line = mean(adj_line), books = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarise(vegas_proj_wins = mean(feed_line), vegas_books = sum(books), vegas_feeds = n(), .groups = "drop")
if (nrow(df_skins) == 0) cat("Vegas: no sportsbook lines in the feed\n", file = stderr())

# C: Scrape TeamRankings
url_tr <- "https://www.teamrankings.com/nba/projections/standings/"
tr_cleaned <- safe_scrape("TeamRankings", {
  webpage_tr <- read_html(url_tr)
  combined_proj <- bind_rows(webpage_tr %>% html_table() %>% .[[1]], webpage_tr %>% html_table() %>% .[[2]])
  combined_proj %>%
    select(team_tr = 1, filter_col = 2, tr_proj_w = 4, tr_proj_l = 5) %>%
    filter(!grepl("overall", filter_col, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(
      tr_proj_w = as.numeric(tr_proj_w),
      tr_proj_l = as.numeric(tr_proj_l)
    )
}, empty = tibble(team_tr = character(), filter_col = character(), tr_proj_w = numeric(), tr_proj_l = numeric()))

# D: Scrape ESPN BPI
url_espn <- "https://www.espn.com/nba/bpi/_/view/projections"
url_espn_api <- "https://site.web.api.espn.com/apis/fitt/v3/sports/basketball/nba/powerindex?region=us&lang=en&limit=50"
espn_cleaned <- safe_scrape("ESPN BPI", {
  # Primary: ESPN's JSON API (the HTML page is often an empty 202 bot check from GitHub's runners)
  espn_api <- tryCatch({
    bpi_json <- fromJSON(content(GET(url_espn_api, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0")), as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"),
                         simplifyVector = FALSE)
    out <- bind_rows(lapply(bpi_json$teams, function(t) {
      proj <- Filter(function(cat) cat$name == "projections", t$categories)[[1]]
      tibble(team = t$team$displayName,
             espn_proj_w = as.numeric(proj$values[[1]]),
             espn_proj_l = as.numeric(proj$values[[2]]))
    }))
    if (nrow(out) < 30 || any(is.na(out$espn_proj_w))) stop("incomplete API data")
    out
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ESPN BPI API failed, trying HTML page:", conditionMessage(e), "\n", file = stderr())
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(espn_api)) {
    espn_api %>% mutate(team = case_when(team == "LA Clippers" ~ "Los Angeles Clippers", TRUE ~ team))
  } else {
    # Fallback: scrape the HTML projections page
    # ESPN can answer with an empty 202 (bot check) - try a few user agents with a short pause
    espn_uas <- c("Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1; +http://www.google.com/bot.html)", "Mozilla/5.0", "")
    espn_html <- ""
    for (attempt in seq_len(6)) {
      ua <- espn_uas[(attempt - 1) %% length(espn_uas) + 1]
      resp_espn <- if (nzchar(ua)) GET(url_espn, user_agent(ua)) else GET(url_espn)
      espn_html <- content(resp_espn, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      if (status_code(resp_espn) == 200 && !is.na(espn_html) && nchar(espn_html) > 1000) break
      Sys.sleep(5)
    }
    if (is.na(espn_html) || nchar(espn_html) <= 1000) stop("empty response (HTTP ", status_code(resp_espn), ")")
    webpage_espn <- read_html(espn_html)
    espn_proj <- bind_cols(webpage_espn %>% html_table() %>% .[[1]], webpage_espn %>% html_table() %>% .[[2]])
    espn_proj %>%
      select(team = Team, ovr_wl = `OVR W-L`) %>%
      separate(ovr_wl, into = c("espn_proj_w", "espn_proj_l"), sep = "-", convert = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(team = case_when(team == "LA Clippers" ~ "Los Angeles Clippers", TRUE ~ team))
  }
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), espn_proj_w = numeric(), espn_proj_l = numeric()))

# E: Scrape CBS Sports
url_cbs <- "https://www.cbssports.com/nba/standings/"
cbs_proj <- safe_scrape("CBS", {
  webpage_cbs <- read_html(url_cbs)
  tables_cbs <- webpage_cbs %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)

  # Extract Eastern and Western conferences
  eastern_conf <- tables_cbs[[1]]
  western_conf <- tables_cbs[[2]]

  # Combine both conferences
  bind_rows(eastern_conf, western_conf) %>%
    select(team_cbs = 2, cbs_proj_w = 16) %>%
    filter(team_cbs != "Team") %>%  # Remove header rows
    mutate(cbs_proj_w = as.numeric(cbs_proj_w))
}, empty = tibble(team_cbs = character(), cbs_proj_w = numeric()))

# F: Scrape Basketball Reference
url_br <- "https://www.basketball-reference.com/friv/playoff_prob.html"
br_proj <- safe_scrape("BB-Ref", {
  webpage_br <- read_html(url_br)
  tables_br <- webpage_br %>% html_table()

  # Fix Eastern Conference
  eastern_conf_br <- tables_br[[1]]
  names(eastern_conf_br) <- make.names(names(eastern_conf_br), unique = TRUE)
  eastern_conf_br <- eastern_conf_br %>%
    slice(-1) %>%  # Remove header row
    select(2, 3) %>%  # Team name, W
    setNames(c("team_br", "br_proj_w"))

  # Fix Western Conference
  western_conf_br <- tables_br[[2]]
  names(western_conf_br) <- make.names(names(western_conf_br), unique = TRUE)
  western_conf_br <- western_conf_br %>%
    slice(-1) %>%  # Remove header row
    select(2, 3) %>%  # Team name, W
    setNames(c("team_br", "br_proj_w"))

  # Combine both conferences
  bind_rows(eastern_conf_br, western_conf_br) %>%
    filter(team_br != "") %>%  # Remove empty rows
    mutate(
      br_proj_w = as.numeric(br_proj_w),
      team = team_br
    ) %>%
    select(team, br_proj_w)
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), br_proj_w = numeric()))

# G: The Analyst (Opta) season simulations - tracked and graded, NOT in the weighted average (trial season 2026-27)
# theanalyst.com/nba-predictions embeds a widget that reads this Opta feed (outlet key and season id from the widget's JS;
# tmcl = 2026/27 NBA season). The feed refuses requests without the widget's Referer.
url_opta_page <- "https://theanalyst.com/nba-predictions"
url_opta <- "https://api.performfeeds.com/basketballdata/tournamentsimulations/1mjq6w6ezkxe611ykkj8rgz7f1?tmcl=b8hmq9h3fea4isg4f04r8ebkk&_fmt=json&_rt=c"
opta_proj <- safe_scrape("Opta", {
  resp_opta <- GET(url_opta, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"), add_headers(Referer = "https://dataviz.theanalyst.com/"))
  if (status_code(resp_opta) != 200) stop("HTTP ", status_code(resp_opta))
  opta_json <- fromJSON(content(resp_opta, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  out <- bind_rows(lapply(opta_json$predictions[[1]]$team, function(t) {
    wins <- Filter(function(x) x$type == "Wins", t$predicted)
    tibble(team = t$name, opta_proj_w = if (length(wins) > 0) as.numeric(wins[[1]]$value) else NA_real_)
  }))
  if (nrow(out) < 30 || any(is.na(out$opta_proj_w))) stop("incomplete data")
  out
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), opta_proj_w = numeric()))

# H: DARKO standings projections - tracked and graded, NOT in the weighted average (trial season 2026-27)
# beta.darko.app/standings is a SvelteKit page; its __data.json holds both conferences in SvelteKit's
# compact format (objects and arrays store indices into one flat list, decoded by darko_resolve)
url_darko_page <- "https://beta.darko.app/standings"
darko_proj <- safe_scrape("DARKO", {
  darko_json <- fromJSON(content(GET(paste0(url_darko_page, "/__data.json"), user_agent("Mozilla/5.0")),
                                 as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  darko_nodes <- Filter(function(n) is.list(n) && identical(n$type, "data"), darko_json$nodes)
  dv <- darko_nodes[[length(darko_nodes)]]$data
  darko_resolve <- function(i) {
    if (i < 0) return(NULL)
    v <- dv[[i + 1]]
    if (is.list(v)) lapply(v, darko_resolve) else v
  }
  root <- darko_resolve(0)
  out <- bind_rows(lapply(c(root$eastStandings, root$westStandings), function(t)
    tibble(team = t$team_name, darko_proj_w = as.numeric(t$W))))
  if (nrow(out) < 30 || any(is.na(out$darko_proj_w))) stop("incomplete data")
  out
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), darko_proj_w = numeric()))

# I: Dunks & Threes playoff probabilities - tracked and graded, NOT in the weighted average (trial season 2026-27)
# The "Win Totals" table: team abbreviation, conference, average wins (abbreviations match draft_data)
url_dnt <- "https://dunksandthrees.com/playoff-probabilities"
dnt_proj <- safe_scrape("Dunks & Threes", {
  tables_dnt <- read_html(GET(url_dnt, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"))) %>% html_table()
  wt <- Filter(function(t) "Win Totals" %in% names(t), tables_dnt)[[1]]
  out <- tibble(abbr = wt[[1]], dnt_proj_w = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(wt[[3]]))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(dnt_proj_w)) %>%
    inner_join(draft_data %>% select(team, abbr), by = "abbr") %>%
    select(team, dnt_proj_w)
  if (nrow(out) < 30) stop("incomplete data")
  out
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), dnt_proj_w = numeric()))

# J: Crafted NBA season projections - tracked and graded, NOT in the weighted average (trial season 2026-27)
# craftednba.com/season-projections (Nuxt) reads /api/team-projections: the latest daily simulation, with
# average_projected_wins per team_code (codes match draft_data). Its preseason run (?baseline=season-start)
# was backfilled into the 2026-10-20 snapshot, so it is graded from opening night like the core sources.
url_crafted <- "https://craftednba.com/api/team-projections"
crafted_proj <- safe_scrape("Crafted NBA", {
  resp_crafted <- GET(url_crafted, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"))
  if (status_code(resp_crafted) != 200) stop("HTTP ", status_code(resp_crafted))
  crafted_json <- fromJSON(content(resp_crafted, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
  if (!isTRUE(crafted_json$success)) stop("API returned success = false")
  tp <- crafted_json$data$team_projections
  out <- tibble(abbr = vapply(tp, function(t) t$team_code, ""),
                crafted_proj_w = vapply(tp, function(t) as.numeric(t$average_projected_wins), 0)) %>%
    inner_join(draft_data %>% select(team, abbr), by = "abbr") %>%
    select(team, crafted_proj_w)
  if (nrow(out) < 30 || any(is.na(out$crafted_proj_w))) stop("incomplete data")
  out
}, empty = tibble(team = character(), crafted_proj_w = numeric()))
# Cloudflare challenges GitHub runners (HTTP 403), so a scheduled Claude Code session fetches the API each
# morning (~4:40 AM Central, after Crafted's ~4 AM run) and commits crafted_latest.csv; used when its run is
# at most 2 days old. Crafted OK'd a once-daily scrape of its public projections (email, Oct 27, 2026).
crafted_file <- "crafted_latest.csv"
if (nrow(crafted_proj) == 0 && file.exists(crafted_file)) {
  crafted_saved <- read.csv(crafted_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  crafted_age <- as.numeric(Sys.Date() - as.Date(crafted_saved$run_date[1]))
  if (nrow(crafted_saved) == 30 && !is.na(crafted_age) && crafted_age <= 2) {
    crafted_proj <- crafted_saved %>% select(team, crafted_proj_w) %>% as_tibble()
    message("Crafted NBA: using ", crafted_file, " (run ", crafted_saved$run_date[1], ")")
  }
}

# --- Step 3: Combine All Projections ---

# Create a master team name crosswalk function to standardize ALL sources
standardize_team_names <- function(df, team_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(team_col) := case_when(
        grepl("Okla City|Oklahoma City", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oklahoma City Thunder",
        grepl("Boston", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Boston Celtics",
        grepl("Cleveland|Cavaliers", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Cleveland Cavaliers",
        grepl("Denver|Nuggets", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Denver Nuggets",
        grepl("Houston|Rockets", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Houston Rockets",
        grepl("New York|Knicks", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "New York Knicks",
        grepl("Orlando|Magic", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Orlando Magic",
        grepl("Minnesota|Timberwolves", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Minnesota Timberwolves",
        grepl("LA Clippers|Clippers", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Los Angeles Clippers",
        grepl("LA Lakers|Lakers", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Los Angeles Lakers",
        grepl("Atlanta|Hawks", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Atlanta Hawks",
        grepl("Golden State|Warriors", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Golden State Warriors",
        grepl("Detroit|Pistons", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Detroit Pistons",
        grepl("Milwaukee|Bucks", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Milwaukee Bucks",
        grepl("San Antonio|Spurs", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "San Antonio Spurs",
        grepl("Philadelphia|76ers|Sixers", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Philadelphia 76ers",
        grepl("Memphis|Grizzlies", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Memphis Grizzlies",
        grepl("Dallas|Mavericks", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Dallas Mavericks",
        grepl("Toronto|Raptors", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Toronto Raptors",
        grepl("Indiana|Pacers", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Indiana Pacers",
        grepl("Miami|Heat", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Miami Heat",
        grepl("Sacramento|Kings", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Sacramento Kings",
        grepl("Portland|Trail Blazers|Blazers", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Portland Trail Blazers",
        grepl("Phoenix|Suns", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Phoenix Suns",
        grepl("Chicago|Bulls", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Chicago Bulls",
        grepl("New Orleans|Pelicans", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "New Orleans Pelicans",
        grepl("Charlotte|Hornets", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Charlotte Hornets",
        grepl("Washington|Wizards", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Washington Wizards",
        grepl("Brooklyn|Nets", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Brooklyn Nets",
        grepl("Utah|Jazz", !!sym(team_col), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Utah Jazz",
        TRUE ~ !!sym(team_col)
      )
    )
}

# Apply standardization to all data sources
df_skins <- df_skins %>% standardize_team_names("team")
nba_standings <- nba_standings %>% standardize_team_names("team")

# TeamRankings crosswalk
tr_cleaned <- tr_cleaned %>%
  rename(team = team_tr) %>%
  standardize_team_names("team") %>%
  select(team, tr_proj_w)

# ESPN BPI already has team column, just standardize it
espn_cleaned <- espn_cleaned %>% standardize_team_names("team")

# CBS Sports team name crosswalk and standardization
cbs_proj <- cbs_proj %>%
  rename(team = team_cbs) %>%
  mutate(
    team = case_when(
      grepl("Golden St", team, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Golden State Warriors",
      grepl("L.A. Lakers", team, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Los Angeles Lakers",
      grepl("L.A. Clippers", team, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Los Angeles Clippers",
      TRUE ~ team
    )
  ) %>%
  standardize_team_names("team") %>%
  select(team, cbs_proj_w)

# Basketball Reference standardization
br_proj <- br_proj %>% standardize_team_names("team")
opta_proj <- opta_proj %>% standardize_team_names("team")
darko_proj <- darko_proj %>% standardize_team_names("team")

# Now combine with consistent team names
# Start with a complete list of all 30 teams to ensure no teams are missing
all_teams <- tibble(
  team = c("Atlanta Hawks", "Boston Celtics", "Brooklyn Nets", "Charlotte Hornets",
           "Chicago Bulls", "Cleveland Cavaliers", "Dallas Mavericks", "Denver Nuggets",
           "Detroit Pistons", "Golden State Warriors", "Houston Rockets", "Indiana Pacers",
           "Los Angeles Clippers", "Los Angeles Lakers", "Memphis Grizzlies", "Miami Heat",
           "Milwaukee Bucks", "Minnesota Timberwolves", "New Orleans Pelicans", "New York Knicks",
           "Oklahoma City Thunder", "Orlando Magic", "Philadelphia 76ers", "Phoenix Suns",
           "Portland Trail Blazers", "Sacramento Kings", "San Antonio Spurs", "Toronto Raptors",
           "Utah Jazz", "Washington Wizards")
)

# Get today's date for historical tracking
today <- as.Date(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d", tz = "America/Chicago"))  # runners use UTC; evening games belong to the Chicago date

# --- Step 4.5: Handle Missing Vegas Data with Historical Values ---
# IMPORTANT: This must happen BEFORE creating df_final_projections
# File to store team-level historical vegas consensus
team_vegas_history_file <- "team_vegas_history.csv"

# Hardcoded fallback values for teams that may be missing from scrape
# (2025-26 values removed for the new season - add a team here if Rotowire drops it with no history yet)
vegas_fallback <- tibble(
  team = character(),
  vegas_proj_wins = numeric()
)

# Load existing team vegas history if it exists
if(file.exists(team_vegas_history_file)) {
  team_vegas_history_raw <- read.csv(team_vegas_history_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  
  # If the old format has vegas_consensus column, reconstruct vegas_proj_wins
  if("vegas_consensus" %in% names(team_vegas_history_raw)) {
    team_vegas_history <- team_vegas_history_raw %>%
      left_join(HARDCODED_PICKS %>% select(team, skins_pick_hardcoded), by = "team") %>%
      mutate(
        # Reconstruct vegas_proj_wins from vegas_consensus using W/L picks
        vegas_proj_wins = if_else(
          is.na(vegas_proj_wins) & !is.na(vegas_consensus),
          if_else(skins_pick_hardcoded == "W", vegas_consensus, 82 - vegas_consensus),
          vegas_proj_wins
        )
      ) %>%
      select(team, vegas_proj_wins, date)
  } else {
    team_vegas_history <- team_vegas_history_raw %>%
      select(any_of(c("team", "vegas_proj_wins", "date", "scraped")))
  }
  # scraped = FALSE marks a value carried forward from an earlier day (rows before Oct 2026 count as scraped)
  if (!"scraped" %in% names(team_vegas_history)) team_vegas_history$scraped <- TRUE
  team_vegas_history <- team_vegas_history %>% mutate(scraped = coalesce(as.logical(scraped), TRUE))
  
  # Remove today's data if it exists
  team_vegas_history <- team_vegas_history %>%
    filter(date != today)
    
} else {
  # Create empty history
  team_vegas_history <- tibble(team = character(), vegas_proj_wins = numeric(), date = as.Date(character()), scraped = logical())
}

# Missing team: carry its last scraped line forward, but only for VEGAS_MAX_CARRY_DAYS.
# Stale feed: in 2025-26 every line froze on Mar 17 for the rest of the season (before that, at least one
# team's line moved every day), so if no line has moved for VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS, Vegas is left out of the blend.
VEGAS_MAX_CARRY_DAYS <- 5
VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS <- 3
last_scraped <- team_vegas_history %>%
  filter(scraped, !is.na(vegas_proj_wins)) %>%
  group_by(team) %>% slice_max(date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(team, last_w = vegas_proj_wins, last_date = date)
all_teams_with_vegas <- all_teams %>%
  left_join(df_skins %>% select(team, vegas_proj_wins), by = "team") %>%
  left_join(vegas_fallback, by = "team", suffix = c("", "_fallback")) %>%
  left_join(last_scraped, by = "team") %>%
  mutate(scraped = !is.na(vegas_proj_wins),
         carry_age = as.numeric(today - last_date),
         vegas_proj_wins = case_when(scraped ~ vegas_proj_wins,
                                     !is.na(last_w) & carry_age <= VEGAS_MAX_CARRY_DAYS ~ last_w,
                                     !is.na(last_w) ~ NA_real_,
                                     TRUE ~ vegas_proj_wins_fallback))
vegas_carry_dropped <- sum(!all_teams_with_vegas$scraped & !is.na(all_teams_with_vegas$last_w) &
                             all_teams_with_vegas$carry_age > VEGAS_MAX_CARRY_DAYS)

# Freeze check: today's scraped lines plus the previous VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS days, and not one has moved
recent_vegas <- bind_rows(
  team_vegas_history %>% filter(scraped, date >= today - VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS, date < today) %>% select(team, date, vegas_proj_wins),
  all_teams_with_vegas %>% filter(scraped) %>% transmute(team, date = today, vegas_proj_wins))
vegas_frozen <- n_distinct(recent_vegas$date) > VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS &&
  nrow(recent_vegas %>% group_by(team) %>% filter(n_distinct(vegas_proj_wins) > 1)) == 0
if (vegas_frozen) cat("Vegas: no line has moved in", VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS, "days - left out of the weighted average\n", file = stderr())

# History keeps every line (scraped or carried) so the freeze check can see when lines start moving again
current_team_vegas <- all_teams_with_vegas %>%
  filter(!is.na(vegas_proj_wins)) %>%
  transmute(team, vegas_proj_wins, date = today, scraped)

# Update df_skins with backfilled values (this replaces the scraped df_skins); a frozen feed is dropped
df_skins <- all_teams_with_vegas %>%
  transmute(team, vegas_proj_wins = if (vegas_frozen) NA_real_ else vegas_proj_wins)

# Add current data to history
team_vegas_history <- bind_rows(team_vegas_history, current_team_vegas) %>%
  arrange(team, date)

# Save updated team vegas history
write.csv(team_vegas_history, team_vegas_history_file, row.names = FALSE)

# NOW create df_final_projections with the backfilled Vegas data
# Join all data sources to the complete team list
# CRITICAL: Join hardcoded W/L picks LAST to overwrite any vestigial inference code
# NOTE: Do NOT join 'player' here - it causes conflicts when joining with draft_data later
df_final_projections <- all_teams %>%
  left_join(draft_data %>% select(team, abbr), by = "team") %>%
  left_join(df_skins, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(tr_cleaned, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(espn_cleaned %>% select(team, espn_proj_w), by = "team") %>%
  left_join(cbs_proj, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(br_proj, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(opta_proj, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(darko_proj, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(dnt_proj, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(crafted_proj, by = "team") %>%
  left_join(nba_standings, by = "team") %>%
  # Join hardcoded picks LAST to ensure they are NEVER overwritten
  left_join(HARDCODED_PICKS, by = "team") %>%
  mutate(
    # Use ONLY the hardcoded pick - never infer from projections
    skins_pick = skins_pick_hardcoded,
    
    # NOW apply the hardcoded W/L pick to each projection source to get skins
    # Vegas: use projected wins if W pick, else use projected losses (82 - wins)
    vegas_consensus = if_else(skins_pick == "W", vegas_proj_wins, 82 - vegas_proj_wins),
    
    # TeamRankings: use projected wins if W pick, else use projected losses
    tr_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", tr_proj_w, 82 - tr_proj_w),
    
    # ESPN BPI: use projected wins if W pick, else use projected losses
    espn_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", espn_proj_w, 82 - espn_proj_w),
    
    # CBS: use projected wins if W pick, else use projected losses
    cbs_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", cbs_proj_w, 82 - cbs_proj_w),
    
    # Basketball Reference: use projected wins if W pick, else use projected losses
    br_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", br_proj_w, 82 - br_proj_w),
    
    # Opta (The Analyst): tracked only, not in the weighted average
    opta_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", opta_proj_w, 82 - opta_proj_w),
    
    # DARKO, Dunks & Threes and Crafted NBA: tracked only, not in the weighted average
    darko_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", darko_proj_w, 82 - darko_proj_w),
    dnt_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", dnt_proj_w, 82 - dnt_proj_w),
    crafted_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", crafted_proj_w, 82 - crafted_proj_w),
    
    # Calculate weighted average using skins (which now correctly apply draft picks)
    # Updated formula to include Basketball Reference
    # Early-season weights; if a source is missing, re-weight across the sources that are available
    wa_weight = WEIGHTS[["vegas"]] * (!is.na(vegas_consensus)) + WEIGHTS[["tr"]] * (!is.na(tr_skins)) +
      WEIGHTS[["espn"]] * (!is.na(espn_skins)) + WEIGHTS[["cbs"]] * (!is.na(cbs_skins)),
    weighted_average = if_else(
      wa_weight > 0,
      (coalesce(vegas_consensus * WEIGHTS[["vegas"]], 0) + coalesce(tr_skins * WEIGHTS[["tr"]], 0) +
         coalesce(espn_skins * WEIGHTS[["espn"]], 0) + coalesce(cbs_skins * WEIGHTS[["cbs"]], 0)) / wa_weight,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Calculate max projection for each team
    max_projection = pmax(weighted_average, vegas_consensus, tr_skins, espn_skins, cbs_skins, br_skins, opta_skins, darko_skins, dnt_skins, crafted_skins, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Calculate actual skins based on HARDCODED pick type from draft (never inferred)
    actual_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", actual_wins, actual_losses),
    
    # Calculate games played and skins percentage
    games_played = actual_wins + actual_losses,
    skins_pct = if_else(games_played > 0, actual_skins / games_played, 0),
    pct_projected = skins_pct * 82
  ) %>%
  # Remove the temporary hardcoded column to keep data clean
  select(-skins_pick_hardcoded, -source, -wa_weight)

# VERIFICATION: Ensure all W/L picks match the hardcoded draft values
verification <- df_final_projections %>%
  select(team, skins_pick) %>%
  left_join(HARDCODED_PICKS %>% select(team, expected = skins_pick_hardcoded), by = "team") %>%
  filter(skins_pick != expected | is.na(skins_pick))

if(draft_complete && nrow(verification) > 0) {
  warning("W/L PICKS DO NOT MATCH DRAFT! Mismatched teams: ", 
          paste(verification$team, collapse = ", "))
}

# --- Step 4.6: Daily team-level projection snapshot (feeds the Projection Accuracy section) ---
# One row per team per Chicago date: every source's projected WINS plus the team's record at that moment.
# Taken on the first run at/after 5 AM Central, when last night's games are final and sources have updated.
proj_history_file <- "team_projection_history.csv"
now_ct <- as.POSIXlt(Sys.time(), tz = "America/Chicago")
snapshot_date <- as.Date(format(now_ct, "%Y-%m-%d"))
proj_history <- if (file.exists(proj_history_file)) {
  read.csv(proj_history_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
} else {
  NULL
}
if (now_ct$hour >= 5 && (is.null(proj_history) || !any(proj_history$date == snapshot_date))) {
  snapshot <- df_final_projections %>%
    transmute(date = snapshot_date, team, wins = actual_wins, losses = actual_losses,
              vegas = vegas_proj_wins, tr = tr_proj_w, espn = espn_proj_w, cbs = cbs_proj_w, br = br_proj_w, opta = opta_proj_w, darko = darko_proj_w, dnt = dnt_proj_w, crafted = crafted_proj_w,
              weighted = if_else(skins_pick == "W", weighted_average, 82 - weighted_average))
  proj_history <- bind_rows(proj_history, snapshot) %>% arrange(date, team)
  write.csv(proj_history, proj_history_file, row.names = FALSE)
}

# --- Step 5: Calculate Player Scores ---
# A player's total for a source is shown only if every one of their teams has a value
# (otherwise a partial sum looks like a real projection) - e.g. CBS before the season
sum_or_na <- function(x) if (any(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x)
# Table display: 1 decimal, dash for missing (tables are rendered with escape = FALSE)
fmt_num <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "&ndash;", sprintf("%.1f", x))

player_scores <- draft_data %>%
  left_join(df_final_projections, by = "team") %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    `Actual Skins` = sum(actual_skins, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Skins %` = if_else(sum(games_played, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                        sum(actual_skins, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(games_played, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    `% Projected` = sum(pct_projected, na.rm = TRUE),  # Sum of team projections
    `Weighted Average` = sum_or_na(weighted_average),
    `Vegas Consensus` = sum_or_na(vegas_consensus),
    `TR` = sum_or_na(tr_skins),
    `ESPN` = sum_or_na(espn_skins),
    `CBS` = sum_or_na(cbs_skins),
    `BB-Ref` = sum_or_na(br_skins),
    `Opta` = sum_or_na(opta_skins),
    `DARKO` = sum_or_na(darko_skins),
    `D&T` = sum_or_na(dnt_skins),
    `Crafted` = sum_or_na(crafted_skins),
    `Max Proj` = sum_or_na(max_projection)
  ) %>%
  mutate(`Proj Avg` = rowMeans(select(., `Vegas Consensus`, `TR`, `ESPN`, `CBS`), na.rm = TRUE),
         `Proj Avg` = if_else(is.nan(`Proj Avg`), NA_real_, `Proj Avg`)) %>%
  select(player, `Actual Skins`, `Skins %`, `% Projected`, `Weighted Average`, 
         `Vegas Consensus`, `TR`, `ESPN`, `CBS`, `BB-Ref`, `Opta`, `DARKO`, `D&T`, `Crafted`, `Proj Avg`, `Max Proj`) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Actual Skins`))

# --- Step 5.5: Projection uncertainty (likely ranges and chance to win) ---
# Each team's final wins = projected wins +/- a miss with two parts, fit on 2025-26 (see README):
#   luck in the games left:                   left * p * (1 - p)        (p = projected win rate the rest of the way)
#   the projection misjudging the team:       TALENT_SD * (left / 82)^1.5, shrinking as the season goes
# Season outcomes are simulated from those team misses and summed into each player's skins.
# Teams on the same roster may miss together. 2025-26: correlation ~0.30 once teams had played ~20 games.
# Checked on 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 player histories (archive/history/): best fit 0.05-0.10 per season,
# 0.15 over all four, phased in from ~0 at opening night to full by ~25 games (see README).
TALENT_SD_2526 <- 8.6   # 2025-26: 9.7-win preseason miss = 4.5 luck + 8.6 misjudged teams
ROSTER_RHO_2526 <- 0.30   # 2025-26 same-roster correlation of skins misses (6 rosters of 5, 20+ games played)
ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR <- 0.15  # starting value and floor (best fit over 2022-26): this season's estimate can raise it, never lower it
MODEL_VERSION <- "2026-10-24 roster-corr 0.15 + vegas-stale guard"   # bump when the simulation changes; saved with every forecast
RHO_RAMP <- c(10, 25)     # league games played: no roster correlation before 10, full by 25 (2025-26: none before ~15-20;
                          # applying it from day 1 made early player ranges too wide, 80% ranges held 92-94%)
N_SIMS <- 10000
talent_sd_now <- TALENT_SD_2526
uncertainty_note <- "last season's projection misses"

# Re-fit from this season once teams have played ~12 games since opening night, blending toward
# this season's own misses until midseason (method of moments on the opening-night snapshot)
if (!is.null(proj_history) && n_distinct(proj_history$date) > 1) {
  open_dates <- proj_history$date[proj_history$date <= SEASON_START]
  open_date <- if (length(open_dates) > 0) max(open_dates) else min(proj_history$date)
  last_date <- max(proj_history$date)
  if (open_date < last_date) {
    fit <- proj_history %>% filter(date == open_date) %>%
      inner_join(proj_history %>% filter(date == last_date) %>% select(team, w1 = wins, l1 = losses), by = "team") %>%
      mutate(g0 = wins + losses, left0 = 82 - g0, played = w1 + l1 - g0, won = w1 - wins,
             rate = pmin(pmax((weighted - wins) / left0, 0.01), 0.99),
             resid = won - rate * played,
             luck = played * rate * (1 - rate),
             talent_scale = ((left0 / 82)^1.5 * played / left0)^2) %>%
      filter(!is.na(weighted), played > 0, left0 > 0)
    if (nrow(fit) >= 20 && mean(fit$played) >= 12) {
      t_hat <- sqrt(max(0, (sum(fit$resid^2) - sum(fit$luck)) / sum(fit$talent_scale)))
      t_hat <- min(max(t_hat, 4), 14)
      blend <- min(1, mean(fit$played) / 41)
      talent_sd_now <- (1 - blend) * TALENT_SD_2526 + blend * t_hat
      uncertainty_note <- sprintf("%.0f%% this season's projection misses (%.0f games per team so far), %.0f%% last season's",
                                  100 * blend, mean(fit$played), 100 * (1 - blend))
    }
  }
}

# Re-fit the roster correlation from this season: skins misses since the first snapshot with 20+ games played,
# from that snapshot's weighted average to today's record, reaching full weight after 41 games, but never below the floor.
rho_now <- ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR
rho_note <- sprintf("%.2f (the floor; last season's was %.2f)", ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR, ROSTER_RHO_2526)
if (draft_complete && !is.null(proj_history) && n_distinct(proj_history$date) > 1) {
  snap_g <- proj_history %>% group_by(date) %>% summarise(g = mean(wins + losses), .groups = "drop")
  rho_dates <- snap_g$date[snap_g$g >= 20]
  if (length(rho_dates) > 0) {
    d0 <- min(rho_dates)
    rw <- proj_history %>% filter(date == d0) %>%
      inner_join(proj_history %>% filter(date == max(proj_history$date)) %>% select(team, w1 = wins, l1 = losses), by = "team") %>%
      inner_join(draft_data %>% select(team, player, skins_pick), by = "team") %>%
      mutate(g0 = wins + losses, left0 = 82 - g0, played = w1 + l1 - g0, won = w1 - wins,
             rate = pmin(pmax((weighted - wins) / left0, 0.01), 0.99),
             r = if_else(skins_pick == "W", 1, -1) * (won - rate * played),
             v = played * rate * (1 - rate) + (talent_sd_now * (left0 / 82)^1.5 * played / left0)^2) %>%
      filter(!is.na(weighted), played > 0, left0 > 0)
    if (nrow(rw) >= 20 && mean(rw$played) >= 12) {
      # standardize each team's miss, then scale by the misses actually seen so a bigger-than-expected
      # spread is not mistaken for clustering: rho = mean same-roster product / mean square
      rw <- rw %>% mutate(zr = r / sqrt(v))
      pairs <- rw %>% group_by(player) %>%
        summarise(num = (sum(zr)^2 - sum(zr^2)) / 2, n_pairs = n() * (n() - 1) / 2, .groups = "drop")
      rho_hat <- min(max((sum(pairs$num) / sum(pairs$n_pairs)) / mean(rw$zr^2), 0), 0.6)
      blend_r <- min(1, mean(rw$played) / 41)
      rho_now <- max(ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR, (1 - blend_r) * ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR + blend_r * rho_hat)
      rho_note <- sprintf("%.2f: %.0f%% this season's (%.2f since %s), %.0f%% the starting %.2f, floor %.2f",
                          rho_now, 100 * blend_r, rho_hat, format(d0, "%b %d"), 100 * (1 - blend_r), ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR, ROSTER_RHO_FLOOR)
    }
  }
}

uncertainty <- NULL
rho_eff <- 0
if (draft_complete) {
  unc_teams <- df_final_projections %>%
    inner_join(draft_data %>% select(team, player), by = "team") %>%
    mutate(left = pmax(82 - (actual_wins + actual_losses), 0),
           proj_w = coalesce(if_else(skins_pick == "W", weighted_average, 82 - weighted_average),
                             vegas_proj_wins, actual_wins + 0.5 * left),
           proj_w = pmin(pmax(proj_w, actual_wins), actual_wins + left),
           rate = if_else(left > 0, pmin(pmax((proj_w - actual_wins) / left, 0.01), 0.99), 0.5),
           sd = sqrt(left * rate * (1 - rate) + (talent_sd_now * (left / 82)^1.5)^2))

  set.seed(as.integer(today))  # same numbers for every run on a given day
  z <- matrix(rnorm(nrow(unc_teams) * N_SIMS), nrow = nrow(unc_teams))
  # Shared roster draw: each player's teams lean the same way in skins (W picks up = L picks down in wins)
  g_now <- mean(unc_teams$actual_wins + unc_teams$actual_losses)
  rho_eff <- rho_now * min(max((g_now - RHO_RAMP[1]) / diff(RHO_RAMP), 0), 1)
  u <- matrix(rnorm(length(PLAYERS) * N_SIMS), nrow = length(PLAYERS))
  side <- if_else(unc_teams$skins_pick == "W", 1, -1)
  z <- sqrt(1 - rho_eff) * z + sqrt(rho_eff) * side * u[match(unc_teams$player, PLAYERS), , drop = FALSE]
  final_w <- pmin(pmax(unc_teams$proj_w + unc_teams$sd * z, unc_teams$actual_wins), unc_teams$actual_wins + unc_teams$left)
  final_skins <- final_w
  l_rows <- unc_teams$skins_pick == "L"
  final_skins[l_rows, ] <- 82 - final_w[l_rows, ]   # L picks earn skins on losses
  sim_player <- rowsum(final_skins, unc_teams$player)   # players x simulated seasons
  sim_winner <- rownames(sim_player)[apply(sim_player, 2, which.max)]

  uncertainty <- tibble(
    player = rownames(sim_player),
    win_prob = as.numeric(table(factor(sim_winner, levels = rownames(sim_player)))) / N_SIMS,
    lo80 = apply(sim_player, 1, quantile, 0.10),
    lo50 = apply(sim_player, 1, quantile, 0.25),
    hi50 = apply(sim_player, 1, quantile, 0.75),
    hi80 = apply(sim_player, 1, quantile, 0.90)
  )
  player_scores <- player_scores %>%
    left_join(uncertainty %>% select(player, `Chance to Win` = win_prob, range_lo = lo80, range_hi = hi80,
                                     range_lo50 = lo50, range_hi50 = hi50), by = "player")
} else {
  player_scores <- player_scores %>% mutate(`Chance to Win` = NA_real_, range_lo = NA_real_, range_hi = NA_real_,
                                            range_lo50 = NA_real_, range_hi50 = NA_real_)
}

# --- Step 6: Prepare Standings Table Data ---
draft_table_data <- df_final_projections %>% 
  select(team, abbr, skins_pick) %>%
  right_join(draft_data, by="team") %>%
  arrange(match(player, PLAYERS))

# --- Step 7: Historical Data Tracking ---
# File to store historical standings
history_file <- "standings_history.csv"

# Calculate current standings for each player (including all projections)
current_standings <- player_scores %>%
  select(
    player, 
    actual_skins = `Actual Skins`,
    skins_pct = `Skins %`,
    pct_projected = `% Projected`,
    weighted_average = `Weighted Average`,
    vegas_consensus = `Vegas Consensus`,
    team_rankings = `TR`,
    espn_bpi = `ESPN`,
    cbs_sports = `CBS`,
    basketball_reference = `BB-Ref`,
    opta = `Opta`,
    darko = `DARKO`,
    dnt = `D&T`,
    crafted = `Crafted`,
    projection_average = `Proj Avg`,
    max_projection = `Max Proj`,
    win_prob = `Chance to Win`,
    range_lo,
    range_hi,
    range_lo50,
    range_hi50
  ) %>%
  # Which model made today's forecast (settings change during the season), for scoring it at season end
  mutate(date = today, model_version = MODEL_VERSION, model_talent_sd = talent_sd_now,
         model_rho = rho_now, model_rho_in_use = rho_eff)

# Pre-draft: keep the old history untouched (player-level history needs the draft)
if(!draft_complete) {
  history <- if(file.exists(history_file)) {
    read.csv(history_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))
  } else {
    current_standings[0, ]
  }
} else if(file.exists(history_file)) {
  history <- read.csv(history_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    filter(date <= today)   # drop rows that UTC-dated evening runs filed under tomorrow
  
  # Add max_projection column if it doesn't exist
  if(!"max_projection" %in% names(history)) {
    history$max_projection <- NA
  }
  
  # Remove today's data if it exists (keep only last render per day)
  history <- history %>%
    filter(date != today) %>%
    bind_rows(current_standings)
} else {
  # Create new history file
  history <- current_standings
}

# Add ONE zero starting point for actual skins chart (day before first real data)
needs_zero_start <- draft_complete && !any(history$actual_skins == 0)

if(needs_zero_start) {
  min_date <- min(history$date)
  zero_start <- tibble(
    player = unique(history$player),
    actual_skins = 0,
    skins_pct = 0,
    pct_projected = 0,
    weighted_average = NA,
    vegas_consensus = NA,
    team_rankings = NA,
    espn_bpi = NA,
    cbs_sports = NA,
    basketball_reference = NA,
    opta = NA,
    darko = NA,
    dnt = NA,
    crafted = NA,
    projection_average = NA,
    max_projection = NA,
    date = min_date - 1
  )
  history <- bind_rows(zero_start, history) %>%
    arrange(date)
}

# Save updated history
if(draft_complete) {
  write.csv(history, history_file, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r display-helpers, echo=FALSE}
# Display helpers: every section below is emitted as raw HTML (sk-* classes, styled at the top of the page)
raw_html <- function(...) cat("\n```{=html}\n", paste0(...), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
sk_dot <- function(p) sprintf("<i class=\"sk-dot\" style=\"--c:%s\"></i>", colorblind_colors[[p]])
sk_f1 <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "&ndash;", sprintf("%.1f", x))
sk_f0 <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "&ndash;", sprintf("%.0f", x))
sk_pct <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "&ndash;", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x))
SK_LINKS <- c(TR = "https://www.teamrankings.com/nba/projections/standings/",
              ESPN = "https://www.espn.com/nba/bpi/_/view/projections",
              CBS = "https://www.cbssports.com/nba/standings/",
              `BB-Ref` = "https://www.basketball-reference.com/friv/playoff_prob.html",
              Opta = "https://theanalyst.com/nba-predictions",
              DARKO = "https://beta.darko.app/standings",
              `D&T` = "https://dunksandthrees.com/playoff-probabilities",
              Crafted = "https://craftednba.com/season-projections")
sk_src_label <- function(l) if (l %in% names(SK_LINKS)) sprintf("<a href='%s' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>%s</a>", SK_LINKS[[l]], l) else l
```

```{r how-it-works, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
raw_html(
  "<details class=\"sk-fold\"><summary>How it works</summary><div class=\"sk-inner\">",
  sprintf("<p><strong><a href='https://bdubcodes.net/posts/the-nba-skins-game'>Skins Game</a>:</strong> players draft all 30 NBA teams and root for each team's WINS or its LOSSES. Every time your chosen outcome happens (e.g. you picked losses for the Spurs and they lose), you get a skin. Whoever has the most skins at the end of the regular season wins. This season is a three-player league (%s) with %d teams each.</p>",
          paste(PLAYERS, collapse = ", "), TEAMS_PER_PLAYER),
  "<dl class=\"sk-facts\">",
  "<dt>Skins % 2023-26</dt><dd><b>58%, 62%, 59%, 59%</b></dd>",
  "<dt>Winner's skins %</dt><dd><b>61%, 68%, 65%, 66%</b> (6-player leagues; with 3 players each roster is a third of the league, so expect this year's winner to finish with a lower %)</dd>",
  "<dt>Skins % projection</dt><dd>Each team's current skins % &times; 82, added up: where a player finishes if every team keeps its current rate.</dd>",
  sprintf("<dt>Weighted avg</dt><dd>Vegas 40%%, TR 20%%, ESPN 20%%, CBS 20%% (most accurate robust blend on 2025-26 Oct-Nov data; until CBS publishes: Vegas 50%%, TR 25%%, ESPN 25%%). A missing Vegas line is carried forward for up to %d days.%s</dd>",
          VEGAS_MAX_CARRY_DAYS,
          if (vegas_frozen) sprintf(" <b>No Vegas line has moved in %d+ days (stale feed), so Vegas is left out until lines update.</b>", VEGAS_FREEZE_DAYS)
          else if (vegas_carry_dropped > 0) sprintf(" %d team(s) left out of Vegas: no line for over %d days.", vegas_carry_dropped, VEGAS_MAX_CARRY_DAYS) else ""),
  "<dt>BB-Ref, Opta, DARKO, D&amp;T, Crafted</dt><dd>Shown and graded for accuracy but not in the weighted average. Opta (The Analyst), DARKO, Dunks &amp; Threes and Crafted NBA are on trial in 2026-27 and may join the blend next season if they prove accurate.</dd>",
  sprintf(paste0("<dt>Chance to win</dt><dd>%s simulated seasons around the weighted average. It narrows as more games are played. ",
                 "Uncertainty is based on %s. Each simulated season draws every team's final wins from a normal distribution ",
                 "around its weighted-average projection, with a spread that combines game-to-game luck in the games left ",
                 "and the chance the projection misjudges the team (currently %.1f wins over a full season, shrinking as games are played); ",
                 "player totals are then summed across their %d teams. Teams on the same roster can miss together, ",
                 "as they did last season: roster correlation %s, phased in between %d and %d games played (%.2f in use now).</dd>"),
          format(N_SIMS, big.mark = ","), uncertainty_note, talent_sd_now, TEAMS_PER_PLAYER,
          rho_note, RHO_RAMP[1], RHO_RAMP[2], rho_eff),
  "</dl></div></details>"
)
```

```{r draft-board, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# PRE-DRAFT MODE: Until every team has a player and W/L pick in draft_data, show a draft board
# (projected wins from every source, the better side to pick, and its projected skins)
if (!draft_complete) {
  n_drafted <- sum(!is.na(draft_data$player))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p style='font-size:14px; color:#ff8a92; margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:16px;'>
     <strong>Pre-draft mode:</strong> %d of 30 teams drafted. Standings, player tables and charts appear once all 30 picks are entered in <code>draft_data</code>.</p>",
    n_drafted))

  cat("\n## Draft Board\n\n")

  draft_board <- df_final_projections %>%
    select(team, abbr, vegas_proj_wins, tr_proj_w, espn_proj_w, cbs_proj_w, br_proj_w, opta_proj_w, darko_proj_w, dnt_proj_w, crafted_proj_w) %>%
    left_join(draft_data %>% select(team, player, skins_pick), by = "team") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(avg_proj_w = mean(c(vegas_proj_wins, tr_proj_w, espn_proj_w, cbs_proj_w, br_proj_w, opta_proj_w, darko_proj_w, dnt_proj_w, crafted_proj_w), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      avg_proj_w = if_else(is.nan(avg_proj_w), NA_real_, avg_proj_w),
      best_side = if_else(avg_proj_w >= 41, "W", "L"),
      best_side_skins = pmax(avg_proj_w, 82 - avg_proj_w)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(best_side_skins))

  fmt1 <- function(x) if_else(is.na(x), "", sprintf("%.1f", x))
  draft_board_display <- draft_board %>%
    transmute(
      Team = team,
      Abbr = abbr,
      `Vegas W` = fmt1(vegas_proj_wins),
      `TR W` = fmt1(tr_proj_w),
      `ESPN W` = fmt1(espn_proj_w),
      `CBS W` = fmt1(cbs_proj_w),
      `BB-Ref W` = fmt1(br_proj_w),
      `Opta W` = fmt1(opta_proj_w),
      `DARKO W` = fmt1(darko_proj_w),
      `D&T W` = fmt1(dnt_proj_w),
      `Crafted W` = fmt1(crafted_proj_w),
      `Avg Proj W` = fmt1(avg_proj_w),
      `Best Side` = coalesce(best_side, ""),
      `Proj Skins` = fmt1(best_side_skins),
      `Drafted By` = if_else(is.na(player), "", paste0(player, coalesce(paste0(" (", skins_pick, ")"), "")))
    )

  table_output <- kable(draft_board_display, align = c("l", "c", rep("r", 10), "c", "r", "l"),
                        format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(8, bold = TRUE) %>%
    column_spec(10, bold = TRUE)

  cat("<div class='sk-tablewrap'>", as.character(table_output), "</div>")
  cat("<p class='sk-note'>Avg Proj W = mean of available sources (projected wins). Best Side = W if Avg Proj W &ge; 41, else L. Proj Skins = projected skins for the best side.</p>")
}
```

```{r standings, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Standings: players across (leader first), stats and projection sources down - fits a phone without scrolling
standing_order <- player_scores %>% arrange(desc(`Actual Skins`), desc(`Weighted Average`)) %>% pull(player)
ps <- player_scores[match(standing_order, player_scores$player), ]

league_total_skins <- sum(df_final_projections$actual_skins, na.rm = TRUE)
league_total_games <- sum(df_final_projections$games_played, na.rm = TRUE)
league_skins_pct <- if_else(league_total_games > 0, league_total_skins / league_total_games, 0)
col_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

# label, per-player values, league average, formatter, row class
st_rows <- list(
  list("Skins", ps$`Actual Skins`, league_total_skins / length(PLAYERS), sk_f0, "sk-key"),
  list("Skins %", ps$`Skins %`, league_skins_pct, sk_pct, ""),
  list("Skins % projection", ps$`% Projected`, col_mean(ps$`% Projected`), sk_f1, ""),
  "Projected final skins",
  list("Weighted avg", ps$`Weighted Average`, col_mean(ps$`Weighted Average`), sk_f1, "sk-key"),
  list("Vegas", ps$`Vegas Consensus`, col_mean(ps$`Vegas Consensus`), sk_f1, ""),
  list("TR", ps$TR, col_mean(ps$TR), sk_f1, ""),
  list("ESPN", ps$ESPN, col_mean(ps$ESPN), sk_f1, ""),
  list("CBS", ps$CBS, col_mean(ps$CBS), sk_f1, ""),
  list("BB-Ref", ps$`BB-Ref`, col_mean(ps$`BB-Ref`), sk_f1, ""),
  list("Opta", ps$Opta, col_mean(ps$Opta), sk_f1, ""),
  list("DARKO", ps$DARKO, col_mean(ps$DARKO), sk_f1, ""),
  list("D&T", ps$`D&T`, col_mean(ps$`D&T`), sk_f1, ""),
  list("Crafted", ps$Crafted, col_mean(ps$Crafted), sk_f1, ""),
  list("Source avg", ps$`Proj Avg`, col_mean(ps$`Proj Avg`), sk_f1, ""),
  list("Max", ps$`Max Proj`, col_mean(ps$`Max Proj`), sk_f1, "")
)
n_cols <- length(standing_order) + 2
st_body <- vapply(st_rows, function(r) {
  if (is.character(r)) return(sprintf("<tr class=\"sk-grp\"><th colspan=\"%d\">%s</th></tr>", n_cols, r))
  vals <- r[[2]]
  best <- if (all(is.na(vals)) || max(vals, na.rm = TRUE) == min(vals, na.rm = TRUE)) NA else max(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  cells <- sprintf("<td data-player=\"%s\"%s>%s</td>", standing_order,
                   if_else(!is.na(best) & !is.na(vals) & vals == best, " class=\"sk-top\"", ""), r[[4]](vals))
  sprintf("<tr class=\"%s\"><td>%s</td>%s<td class=\"sk-avg\">%s</td></tr>",
          r[[5]], sk_src_label(r[[1]]), paste(cells, collapse = ""), r[[4]](r[[3]]))
}, character(1))

raw_html(
  "<h2 class=\"sk-h\">Standings</h2>",
  "<div class=\"sk-tablewrap\"><table class=\"sk-table\" id=\"sk-standings\" data-quarto-disable-processing=\"true\"><thead><tr><th></th>",
  paste(sprintf("<th data-player=\"%s\">%s%s</th>", standing_order, vapply(standing_order, sk_dot, ""), standing_order), collapse = ""),
  "<th class=\"sk-avg\">Avg</th></tr></thead><tbody>", paste(st_body, collapse = ""), "</tbody></table></div>",
  "<p class=\"sk-note\">Skins % projection = each team's skins % &times; 82, added up. Projected rows are final-season skins from each source; bold = best in the row. Avg = league average per player.</p>"
)
```

```{r chance-to-win, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Chance to win: title odds bar, then one card per player with the likely range on a shared scale
if (!is.null(uncertainty)) {
  cw <- uncertainty %>%
    left_join(player_scores %>% select(player, proj = `Weighted Average`), by = "player") %>%
    arrange(desc(win_prob), desc(proj))
  span <- max(cw$hi80) - min(cw$lo80)
  step <- c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100)[which(span / c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100) <= 6)[1]]
  ax_lo <- floor((min(cw$lo80) - step / 4) / step) * step
  ax_hi <- ceiling((max(cw$hi80) + step / 4) / step) * step
  xp <- function(v) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * (v - ax_lo) / (ax_hi - ax_lo))
  ticks <- seq(ax_lo, ax_hi, by = step)
  grid <- paste(sprintf("<i class=\"sk-grid\" style=\"left:%s\"></i>", xp(ticks)), collapse = "")

  odds <- paste0(
    "<div class=\"sk-odds\"><div class=\"sk-k\">Chance to win the league</div>",
    sprintf("<div class=\"sk-bar\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"%s\">", paste(sprintf("%s %.0f%%", cw$player, 100 * cw$win_prob), collapse = ", ")),
    paste(sprintf("<span style=\"--c:%s;flex:%.4f\"></span>", colorblind_colors[cw$player], cw$win_prob), collapse = ""),
    "</div><div class=\"sk-leg\">",
    paste(sprintf("<span>%s%s <b>%.0f%%</b></span>", vapply(cw$player, sk_dot, ""), cw$player, 100 * cw$win_prob), collapse = ""),
    "</div></div>")
  cards <- paste(sprintf(paste0(
    "<article class=\"sk-pc\" data-player=\"%s\" style=\"--c:%s\">",
    "<div class=\"sk-pc-top\"><span class=\"sk-rank\">%d</span><i class=\"sk-dot\"></i><span class=\"sk-nm\">%s</span>",
    "<span class=\"sk-win\"><b>%.0f%%</b><small>to win</small></span></div>",
    "<div class=\"sk-pc-sub\">Projected <b>%.0f</b> &middot; likely %.0f&ndash;%.0f</div>",
    "<div class=\"sk-range\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"%s: projected %.0f, likely range %.0f to %.0f\">%s",
    "<i class=\"sk-r80\" style=\"left:%s;width:calc(%s - %s)\"></i>",
    "<i class=\"sk-r50\" style=\"left:%s;width:calc(%s - %s)\"></i>",
    "<i class=\"sk-pt\" style=\"left:%s\"></i></div></article>"),
    cw$player, colorblind_colors[cw$player], seq_len(nrow(cw)), cw$player, 100 * cw$win_prob,
    cw$proj, cw$lo80, cw$hi80, cw$player, cw$proj, cw$lo80, cw$hi80, grid,
    xp(cw$lo80), xp(cw$hi80), xp(cw$lo80), xp(cw$lo50), xp(cw$hi50), xp(cw$lo50), xp(cw$proj)), collapse = "")

  raw_html(
    "<h2 class=\"sk-h\">Chance to win</h2>",
    "<div class=\"sk-caveat\" role=\"note\">The model behind these probabilities is built on just one season of data (2025-26). ",
    "Expect it to be inaccurate, especially early in the season.</div>",
    odds,
    "<div class=\"sk-cards\">", cards, "</div>",
    "<div class=\"sk-axis\">", paste(sprintf("<span style=\"left:%s\">%d</span>", xp(ticks), as.integer(ticks)), collapse = ""), "</div>",
    sprintf("<p class=\"sk-note\">Projected final skins: dot = weighted average, thick bar = 1-in-2 range, thin bar = 4-in-5 range, from %s simulated seasons.</p>",
            format(N_SIMS, big.mark = ","))
  )
}
```

```{r rosters, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Rosters: one player at a time (tabs), each team expandable to its source-by-source numbers
roster_teams <- draft_data %>%
  left_join(df_final_projections %>% select(-abbr, -skins_pick), by = "team") %>%
  mutate(proj_avg = rowMeans(cbind(vegas_consensus, tr_skins, espn_skins, cbs_skins), na.rm = TRUE),
         proj_avg = if_else(is.nan(proj_avg), NA_real_, proj_avg))
# Preseason projection = weighted average from the last snapshot on or before opening night, as skins for the drafted side
pre_dates <- if (is.null(proj_history)) as.Date(character(0)) else proj_history$date[proj_history$date <= SEASON_START]
pre_date <- if (length(pre_dates) > 0) max(pre_dates) else NA
roster_teams <- roster_teams %>%
  left_join(if (is.na(pre_date)) tibble(team = character(0), pre_w = numeric(0))
            else proj_history %>% filter(date == pre_date) %>% select(team, pre_w = weighted), by = "team") %>%
  mutate(pre_skins = if_else(skins_pick == "W", pre_w, 82 - pre_w),
         vs_pre = weighted_average - pre_skins)

roster_html <- vapply(PLAYERS, function(p) {
  ts <- roster_teams %>% filter(player == p) %>% arrange(desc(actual_skins), desc(weighted_average))
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(ts)), function(i) {
    t <- ts[i, ]
    pace <- if (t$games_played > 0) {
      sprintf("<span class=\"sk-pill %s\" title=\"%+.1f vs projection\">%.0f</span>",
              if (is.na(t$weighted_average) || t$pct_projected >= t$weighted_average) "pos" else "neg",
              t$pct_projected - coalesce(t$weighted_average, t$pct_projected), t$pct_projected)
    } else "&ndash;"
    srcs <- c(`Skins %` = sk_pct(if (t$games_played > 0) t$skins_pct else NA), Vegas = sk_f1(t$vegas_consensus),
              TR = sk_f1(t$tr_skins), ESPN = sk_f1(t$espn_skins), CBS = sk_f1(t$cbs_skins),
              `BB-Ref` = sk_f1(t$br_skins), Opta = sk_f1(t$opta_skins),
              DARKO = sk_f1(t$darko_skins), `D&T` = sk_f1(t$dnt_skins),
              Crafted = sk_f1(t$crafted_skins), `Source avg` = sk_f1(t$proj_avg), Max = sk_f1(t$max_projection))
    sprintf(paste0(
      "<details><summary class=\"sk-rrow\"><span class=\"sk-tm\">%s <span class=\"sk-pick\" title=\"%s\">%s</span></span>",
      "<span>%d</span><span>%s</span><span><b>%s</b><div class=\"sk-mini\"><span style=\"width:%.1f%%\"></span></div></span>",
      "<span class=\"sk-chev\" aria-hidden=\"true\">&#9654;</span></summary>",
      "<div class=\"sk-srcs\"><div class=\"sk-tfull\">%s &middot; %s</div>%s</div></details>"),
      t$abbr, if (t$skins_pick == "W") "Wins" else "Losses", t$skins_pick,
      as.integer(t$actual_skins), pace,
      sk_f1(t$weighted_average), 100 * coalesce(t$weighted_average, 0) / 82,
      t$team, if (t$skins_pick == "W") "picked to win" else "picked to lose",
      paste(sprintf("<div><span>%s</span>%s</div>", names(srcs), srcs), collapse = ""))
  }, character(1))
  sprintf("<div class=\"sk-roster\" data-roster=\"%s\" data-player=\"%s\"><div class=\"sk-rname\">%s%s</div><div class=\"sk-rhead\"><span>Team</span><span>Skins</span><span>%% Proj</span><span>Proj</span><span></span></div>%s</div>",
          p, p, sk_dot(p), p, paste(rows, collapse = ""))
}, character(1))

raw_html(
  "<h2 class=\"sk-h\">Rosters</h2>",
  sprintf("<div class=\"sk-who\"><span class=\"sk-seg\" id=\"sk-rtabs\" data-default=\"%s\">%s</span></div>", standing_order[1],
          paste(sprintf("<button type=\"button\" data-p=\"%s\">%s</button>", PLAYERS, PLAYERS), collapse = "")),
  paste(roster_html, collapse = ""),
  "<p class=\"sk-note\">Skins = skins so far. % Proj = skins % projection (skins % &times; 82), green when ahead of the projection. Proj = weighted-average final skins. Tap a team for every source.</p>"
)
```
