```{r projection-accuracy, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5, dpi=150, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# How well did each source's projection on date D predict what teams did AFTER D?
# Sources already include results to date, so we only grade games played after the projection was saved:
#   expected wins since D = (projected wins - wins at D) / (games left at D) * games played since D
#   miss = |actual wins since D - expected wins since D|, averaged over teams (in wins)
ACC_SOURCES <- c(tr = "TeamRankings", espn = "ESPN BPI", cbs = "CBS", vegas = "Vegas", br = "BB-Ref", opta = "Opta", darko = "DARKO", dnt = "Dunks & Threes", crafted = "Crafted NBA",
                 weighted = "Weighted Average", baseline = "Baseline: .500 rest of season")
MIN_GAMES <- 12   # average games per team since the projection before a window is graded (~4 weeks)
acc_p <- function(txt, size = 14) cat(sprintf("<p style='font-size:%dpx; margin-top:4px; margin-bottom:6px;'>%s</p>\n", size, txt))

h <- if (is.null(proj_history)) NULL else proj_history %>% mutate(baseline = wins + 0.5 * (82 - wins - losses))

# Per-team expected vs actual wins between two snapshots
window_detail <- function(from_date, to_date) {
  end <- h %>% filter(date == to_date) %>% select(team, wins_end = wins, losses_end = losses)
  h %>% filter(date == from_date) %>%
    inner_join(end, by = "team") %>%
    mutate(g0 = wins + losses, played = wins_end + losses_end - g0, won = wins_end - wins) %>%
    filter(played > 0, g0 < 82)
}
score_window <- function(from_date, to_date) {
  d <- window_detail(from_date, to_date)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  d %>%
    pivot_longer(any_of(names(ACC_SOURCES)), names_to = "source", values_to = "proj") %>%
    filter(!is.na(proj)) %>%
    mutate(expected = (proj - wins) / (82 - g0) * played, miss = abs(won - expected)) %>%
    group_by(source) %>%
    summarise(miss = mean(miss), teams = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(games = mean(d$played))
}
pick_start <- function(on_or_before) {
  d <- h$date[h$date <= on_or_before]
  if (length(d) == 0) NA else max(d)
}

if (is.null(h) || nrow(h) == 0) {
  acc_p("Tracking starts with the first daily snapshot of every source's team projections.")
} else {
  latest <- max(h$date)
  opening <- pick_start(SEASON_START)
  if (is.na(opening)) opening <- min(h$date)
  last30 <- pick_start(latest - 30)

  windows <- list(opening = opening, last30 = last30)
  scores <- lapply(windows, function(d) if (is.na(d) || d >= latest) NULL else score_window(d, latest))
  enough <- sapply(scores, function(x) !is.null(x) && x$games[1] >= MIN_GAMES)
  games_txt <- sapply(scores, function(x) if (is.null(x)) "0" else sprintf("%.0f", x$games[1]))

  # Sources added after opening night (Opta, DARKO, Dunks & Threes in 2026-27) are graded "since opening" from their first saved projection
  late_start <- list()
  for (k in setdiff(names(ACC_SOURCES), "baseline")) {
    if (!k %in% names(h) || any(!is.na(h[[k]][h$date == opening]))) next
    dates_k <- h$date[!is.na(h[[k]])]
    if (length(dates_k) == 0 || min(dates_k) >= latest) next
    x <- score_window(min(dates_k), latest)
    x <- x[x$source == k, ]
    if (nrow(x) == 1 && x$games >= MIN_GAMES) late_start[[k]] <- list(date = min(dates_k), miss = x$miss)
  }

  if (!any(enough)) {
    acc_p(paste0("Will have enough data around mid-November. This section will evaluate the accuracy of the projection models. ",
                 "Every source&rsquo;s projected wins are saved daily and each is graded: the average miss between a team&rsquo;s actual wins ",
                 "and the wins its projection implied for those games."))
  } else {
    col_for <- function(key) {
      x <- scores[[key]]
      if (!enough[[key]]) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(ACC_SOURCES)), names(ACC_SOURCES)))
      out <- setNames(x$miss[match(names(ACC_SOURCES), x$source)], names(ACC_SOURCES))
      if (key == "opening") for (k in names(late_start)) out[[k]] <- late_start[[k]]$miss
      out
    }
    acc <- tibble(key = names(ACC_SOURCES), Source = unname(ACC_SOURCES),
                  opening = col_for("opening"), last30 = col_for("last30"),
                  weight = case_when(key %in% names(WEIGHTS) ~ sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * WEIGHTS[key]),
                                     TRUE ~ "&ndash;")) %>%
      filter(!(is.na(opening) & is.na(last30))) %>%
      arrange(coalesce(last30, opening))

    # Bold the best source (baseline excluded) in each column
    fmt_col <- function(x, keys) {
      real <- !(keys %in% c("baseline"))
      best <- if (any(!is.na(x[real]))) min(x[real], na.rm = TRUE) else NA
      ifelse(is.na(x), "&ndash;", ifelse(!is.na(best) & x == best & real, sprintf("<b>%.2f</b>", x), sprintf("%.2f", x)))
    }
    acc_display <- acc %>%
      transmute(Source = if_else(key %in% names(late_start), paste0(Source, "*"), Source),
                opening = fmt_col(opening, key),
                last30 = fmt_col(last30, key),
                weight)

    raw_html("<div class=\"sk-tablewrap\"><table class=\"sk-table\" data-quarto-disable-processing=\"true\"><thead><tr>",
             "<th>Source</th><th>Since opening</th><th>Last 30 days</th><th>Weight</th></tr></thead><tbody>",
             paste(sprintf("<tr><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>",
                           acc_display$Source, acc_display$opening, acc_display$last30, acc_display$weight), collapse = ""),
             "</tbody></table></div>")
    acc_p(sprintf(paste0("Average miss in wins per team, grading only games played <i>after</i> each projection was saved ",
                         "(opening night: %s, %s games per team; last 30 days: %s). Lower is better; best source in bold. ",
                         "The .500 baseline shows how much the projections beat a coin flip."),
                  format(opening, "%b %d"), games_txt[["opening"]],
                  if (enough[["last30"]]) sprintf("since %s, %s games per team", format(last30, "%b %d"), games_txt[["last30"]])
                  else "not enough games yet"), 13)
    if (length(late_start) > 0)
      acc_p(paste0("* Not tracked on opening night; graded since its first saved projection (",
                   paste(sprintf("%s: %s", ACC_SOURCES[names(late_start)],
                                 vapply(late_start, function(x) format(x$date, "%b %d"), "")), collapse = "; "),
                   "). Opta, DARKO, Dunks &amp; Threes and Crafted NBA are tracked for accuracy only and are not in the weighted average."), 13)

    # Suggested weights: TR/ESPN/CBS mix (5% steps) with the smallest miss over the most recent graded window
    key_w <- if (enough[["last30"]]) "last30" else "opening"
    d <- window_detail(windows[[key_w]], latest)
    avail <- names(WEIGHTS)[sapply(names(WEIGHTS), function(k) k %in% names(d) && any(!is.na(d[[k]])))]
    d <- d %>% filter(if_all(all_of(avail), ~ !is.na(.x)))
    if (length(avail) >= 2 && nrow(d) >= 20) {
      grid <- expand.grid(rep(list(seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)), length(avail)))
      names(grid) <- avail
      grid <- grid[abs(rowSums(grid) - 1) < 1e-9, , drop = FALSE]
      P <- as.matrix(d[, avail])
      miss_for <- function(w) {
        proj <- as.vector(P %*% w)
        mean(abs(d$won - (proj - d$wins) / (82 - d$g0) * d$played))
      }
      grid_miss <- apply(grid, 1, function(w) miss_for(as.numeric(w)))
      best_w <- unlist(grid[which.min(grid_miss), , drop = FALSE])
      cur_w <- WEIGHTS[avail] / sum(WEIGHTS[avail])
      lbl <- c(vegas = "Vegas", tr = "TR", espn = "ESPN", cbs = "CBS")
      fmt_w <- function(w) paste(sprintf("%s %.0f%%", lbl[names(w)], 100 * w), collapse = ", ")
      acc_p(sprintf("<b>Suggested weights</b> (best fit over the %s): %s &mdash; miss %.2f vs %.2f with current weights (%s).",
                    if (key_w == "last30") "last 30 days" else "season so far",
                    fmt_w(best_w), min(grid_miss), miss_for(as.numeric(cur_w)), fmt_w(cur_w)), 13)
    }

    # Trend: rolling 30-day miss for each source, as of each snapshot date
    trend <- bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(h$date)), function(a) {
      d0 <- pick_start(a - 30)
      if (is.na(d0) || d0 >= a) return(NULL)
      x <- score_window(d0, a)
      if (is.null(x) || x$games[1] < MIN_GAMES) return(NULL)
      x %>% mutate(date = a)
    }))
    if (nrow(trend) > 1) {
      trend <- trend %>% mutate(Source = factor(ACC_SOURCES[source], levels = ACC_SOURCES))
      print(
        ggplot(trend, aes(date, miss, color = Source, linetype = source == "baseline")) +
          geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
          scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
          scale_color_manual(values = c("TeamRankings" = "#4C9BE8", "ESPN BPI" = "#E26A54", "CBS" = "#22A794",
                                        "Vegas" = "#EE9944", "BB-Ref" = "#CC6FA8", "Opta" = "#B8C94A", "DARKO" = "#9C8AE0",
                                        "Dunks & Threes" = "#E0B04A", "Crafted NBA" = "#5BC8D6", "Weighted Average" = "#EEEEEE",
                                        "Baseline: .500 rest of season" = "#888888")) +
          labs(title = "Rolling 30-day miss by source", subtitle = "Lower is better", x = NULL,
               y = "Average miss (wins per team)", color = NULL) +
          guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 3)) +
          theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
          theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
                plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#2b2b2b", color = NA),
                panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#3a3a3a"),
                text = element_text(color = "#dddddd"), axis.text = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa"))
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Standings page behaviour: "I'm" picker (shared with Daily Matchups via localStorage skinsMe), roster tabs,
// sortable all-teams table, and the season charts drawn from the embedded #sk-data JSON.
(function () {
  document.body.classList.add("sk-js");
  var KEY = "skinsMe";
  var dataEl = document.getElementById("sk-data");
  if (!dataEl) return;   // pre-draft: nothing below exists yet
  var D = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent);
  var PLAYERS = D.players, COLORS = D.colors;
  var me = "";
  try { me = localStorage.getItem(KEY) || ""; } catch (e) {}
  if (PLAYERS.indexOf(me) < 0) me = "";

  var esc = function (s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); };
  var dot = function (p) { return '<i class="sk-dot" style="--c:' + COLORS[p] + '"></i>'; };

  // --- "I'm" picker ---
  var meEl = document.getElementById("sk-me");
  function renderPicker() {
    if (!meEl) return;
    meEl.innerHTML = PLAYERS.concat([""]).map(function (p) {
      return '<button type="button" data-me="' + esc(p) + '" aria-pressed="' + (p === me) + '">' + esc(p || "All") + "</button>";
    }).join("");
    meEl.parentElement.hidden = false;
  }
  function applyMe() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-player]").forEach(function (el) { el.classList.toggle("sk-me", !!me && el.getAttribute("data-player") === me); });
  }
  if (meEl) meEl.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
    me = b.getAttribute("data-me");
    try { me ? localStorage.setItem(KEY, me) : localStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (err) {}
    renderPicker(); applyMe(); if (me) showRoster(me); if (tabs) drawChart();
  });

  // --- roster tabs ---
  var rt = document.getElementById("sk-rtabs");
  function showRoster(p) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sk-roster").forEach(function (r) { r.hidden = r.getAttribute("data-roster") !== p; });
    if (rt) rt.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-p") === p); });
  }
  if (rt) rt.addEventListener("click", function (e) { var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (b) showRoster(b.getAttribute("data-p")); });

  // --- sortable all-teams table ---
  var all = document.getElementById("sk-all");
  if (all) all.tHead.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("button[data-col]"); if (!b) return;
    var c = +b.getAttribute("data-col"), mode = b.getAttribute("data-num"), tb = all.tBodies[0];   // 0 text, 1 high-first, 2 low-first
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(tb.rows);
    rows.sort(function (x, y) {
      var a = x.cells[c].getAttribute("data-v"), z = y.cells[c].getAttribute("data-v");
      return mode === "1" ? (+z) - (+a) : mode === "2" ? (+a) - (+z) : a.localeCompare(z);
    });
    rows.forEach(function (r) { tb.appendChild(r); });
    all.tHead.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (x) { x.removeAttribute("aria-sort"); });
    b.setAttribute("aria-sort", mode === "1" ? "descending" : "ascending");
  });

  // --- season charts ---
  var dates = [], byDate = {};
  D.hist.forEach(function (h) { if (!byDate[h.d]) { byDate[h.d] = {}; dates.push(h.d); } byDate[h.d][h.p] = h; });
  dates.sort();
  var H = dates.map(function (d) { return { d: d, t: new Date(d + "T12:00:00").getTime(), r: byDate[d] }; });
  var firstGame = -1;
  for (var i = 0; i < H.length && firstGame < 0; i++) if (PLAYERS.some(function (p) { return H[i].r[p] && H[i].r[p].sk > 0; })) firstGame = i;
  var avgOf = function (row, k) { var s = 0, n = 0; PLAYERS.forEach(function (p) { if (row[p] && row[p][k] != null) { s += row[p][k]; n++; } }); return n ? s / n : null; };
  var f0 = function (v) { return v.toFixed(0); }, f1 = function (v) { return v.toFixed(1); };
  var CH = {
    proj: { ttl: "Projected final skins",
      opts: [["wa", "Weighted avg"], ["v", "Vegas"], ["tr", "TR"], ["es", "ESPN"], ["cb", "CBS"], ["br", "BB-Ref"], ["op", "Opta"], ["dk", "DARKO"], ["dt", "D&amp;T"], ["cr", "Crafted"], ["avg", "Source avg"], ["mx", "Max"], ["pace", "Skins % projection"]],
      dsc: function (o) { return o === "wa" ? "Weighted average with the 4-in-5 likely range (dashed). Pick yourself above to see just your range." : o === "pace" ? "Each team's skins % × 82, added up." : "Projected final skins from this source."; },
      get: function (r, o) { return o === "pace" && !(r.pace > 0) ? null : r[o]; }, band: function (o) { return o === "wa"; },
      games: function (o) { return o === "pace"; }, fmt: f0, tip: f1 },
    race: { ttl: "Skins race", opts: [["gap", "vs. league average"], ["sk", "Total skins"]],
      dsc: function (o) { return o === "gap" ? "Above zero means ahead of the average player. The gap between lines is the lead." : "Skins so far."; },
      get: function (r, o, row) { if (r.sk == null) return null; return o === "gap" ? r.sk - avgOf(row, "sk") : r.sk; },
      zero: function (o) { return o === "gap"; }, games: function () { return true; },
      fmt: function (v, o) { return (o === "gap" && v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(0); } },
    pct: { ttl: "Skins %", dsc: function () { return "Share of games so far that earned a skin."; },
      get: function (r) { return r.pct > 0 ? r.pct : null; }, games: function () { return true; },
      fmt: function (v) { return (100 * v).toFixed(1) + "%"; } },
    win: { ttl: "Chance to win", dsc: function () { return "From " + D.sims.toLocaleString() + " simulated seasons each day. Built on one season of data, so treat it as rough."; },
      get: function (r) { return r.win; }, dom: [0, 1], ticks: [0, .25, .5, .75, 1],
      fmt: function (v) { return Math.round(100 * v) + "%"; } }
  };
  var state = { c: "proj", o: { proj: "wa", race: "gap" } };
  var tabs = document.getElementById("sk-ctabs"), sel = document.getElementById("sk-copt"), plot = document.getElementById("sk-plot");

  function niceTicks(a, b) {
    if (a === b) { a -= 1; b += 1; }
    var step0 = (b - a) / 4, mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)));
    var step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(function (m) { return m * mag; }).filter(function (s) { return s >= step0; })[0];
    var t = []; for (var v = Math.floor(a / step) * step; v <= b + step * 1e-6; v += step) t.push(+v.toFixed(6));
    if (t[t.length - 1] < b) t.push(+(t[t.length - 1] + step).toFixed(6));
    return t;
  }

  function drawChart() {
    var c = CH[state.c], o = state.o[state.c];
    tabs.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-c") === state.c); });
    if (c.opts) {
      sel.innerHTML = c.opts.map(function (x) { return '<option value="' + x[0] + '"' + (x[0] === o ? " selected" : "") + ">" + x[1] + "</option>"; }).join("");
      sel.hidden = false;
    } else sel.hidden = true;
    document.getElementById("sk-cttl").textContent = c.ttl;
    document.getElementById("sk-cdsc").textContent = c.dsc(o);
    document.getElementById("sk-cleg").innerHTML = PLAYERS.map(function (p) { return "<span>" + dot(p) + esc(p) + "</span>"; }).join("");

    var from = 0;
    if (c.games && c.games(o)) {
      if (firstGame < 0) { plot.innerHTML = '<div class="sk-empty">Starts once the first games go final.</div>'; return; }
      from = Math.max(0, firstGame - 1);
    }
    var pts = H.slice(from);
    var series = PLAYERS.map(function (p) {
      return { p: p,
        v: pts.map(function (h) { var r = h.r[p]; return r ? c.get(r, o, h.r) : null; }),
        lo: pts.map(function (h) { var r = h.r[p]; return r && c.band && c.band(o) ? r.lo : null; }),
        hi: pts.map(function (h) { var r = h.r[p]; return r && c.band && c.band(o) ? r.hi : null; }) };
    });
    var vals = [];
    series.forEach(function (s) { s.v.concat(s.lo, s.hi).forEach(function (v) { if (v != null) vals.push(v); }); });
    if (!vals.length) { plot.innerHTML = '<div class="sk-empty">No data for this chart yet.</div>'; return; }

    var W = Math.max(280, plot.clientWidth || 600), Hh = Math.round(Math.min(320, Math.max(220, W * 0.58)));
    var m = { l: 44, r: 76, t: 10, b: 24 };
    var y0 = c.dom ? c.dom[0] : Math.min.apply(null, vals), y1 = c.dom ? c.dom[1] : Math.max.apply(null, vals);
    if (c.zero && c.zero(o)) { y0 = Math.min(y0, 0); y1 = Math.max(y1, 0); }
    var yt = c.ticks || niceTicks(y0, y1);
    y0 = Math.min(y0, yt[0]); y1 = Math.max(y1, yt[yt.length - 1]);
    var t0 = pts[0].t, t1 = pts[pts.length - 1].t;
    var xs = function (i) { return m.l + (t1 === t0 ? 0.5 : (pts[i].t - t0) / (t1 - t0)) * (W - m.l - m.r); };
    var ys = function (v) { return m.t + (1 - (v - y0) / ((y1 - y0) || 1)) * (Hh - m.t - m.b); };
    var fmtD = function (d) { return new Date(d + "T12:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric" }); };
    var n = pts.length;
    var xIdx = n <= 4 ? pts.map(function (_, i) { return i; }) : [0, Math.round((n - 1) / 3), Math.round(2 * (n - 1) / 3), n - 1];
    var fmt = function (v) { return c.fmt(v, o); };
    var line = function (arr) {
      var d = "", on = false;
      arr.forEach(function (v, i) { if (v == null) { on = false; return; } d += (on ? "L" : "M") + xs(i).toFixed(1) + " " + ys(v).toFixed(1); on = true; });
      return d;
    };
    var svg = '<svg width="' + W + '" height="' + Hh + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + " " + Hh + '" role="img" aria-label="' + esc(c.ttl) + ' chart">';
    yt.forEach(function (t) {
      var z = c.zero && c.zero(o) && t === 0;
      svg += '<line x1="' + m.l + '" x2="' + (W - m.r) + '" y1="' + ys(t) + '" y2="' + ys(t) + '" stroke="' + (z ? "#888" : "#3a3a3a") + '" stroke-width="1"/>' +
        '<text x="' + (m.l - 6) + '" y="' + (ys(t) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + fmt(t) + "</text>";
    });
    xIdx.forEach(function (i) {
      svg += '<text x="' + xs(i) + '" y="' + (Hh - 6) + '" text-anchor="' + (i === 0 && n > 1 ? "start" : i === n - 1 && n > 1 ? "end" : "middle") + '">' + fmtD(pts[i].d) + "</text>";
    });
    // Likely-range bands overlap heavily early in the season: once a player picks themselves, only their band is drawn
    series.forEach(function (s) {
      if (me && s.p !== me) return;
      var idx = []; s.lo.forEach(function (v, i) { if (v != null && s.hi[i] != null) idx.push(i); });
      if (idx.length < 2) return;
      var top = idx.map(function (i) { return xs(i) + " " + ys(s.hi[i]); }), bot = idx.slice().reverse().map(function (i) { return xs(i) + " " + ys(s.lo[i]); });
      svg += '<path d="M' + top.join("L") + "L" + bot.join("L") + 'Z" fill="' + COLORS[s.p] + '" fill-opacity="' + (me ? ".18" : ".08") + '"/>' +
        '<path d="M' + top.join("L") + "M" + bot.join("L") + '" fill="none" stroke="' + COLORS[s.p] + '" stroke-opacity=".45" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>';
    });
    series.forEach(function (s) { svg += '<path d="' + line(s.v) + '" fill="none" stroke="' + COLORS[s.p] + '" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>'; });
    var ends = [];
    series.forEach(function (s) { var last = -1; s.v.forEach(function (v, i) { if (v != null) last = i; }); if (last >= 0) ends.push({ s: s, i: last, y: ys(s.v[last]) }); });
    ends.sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
    for (var k = 1; k < ends.length; k++) if (ends[k].y - ends[k - 1].y < 15) ends[k].y = ends[k - 1].y + 15;
    ends.forEach(function (e) {
      svg += '<circle cx="' + xs(e.i) + '" cy="' + ys(e.s.v[e.i]) + '" r="4" fill="' + COLORS[e.s.p] + '" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="2"/>' +
        '<text class="sk-end" x="' + (xs(e.i) + 8) + '" y="' + (e.y + 4) + '">' + esc(e.s.p.slice(0, 3)) + " " + fmt(e.s.v[e.i]) + "</text>";
    });
    svg += '<line class="sk-xh" y1="' + m.t + '" y2="' + (Hh - m.b) + '" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" visibility="hidden"/>' +
      '<rect class="sk-hit" x="' + m.l + '" y="0" width="' + (W - m.l - m.r) + '" height="' + Hh + '" fill="transparent"/></svg>';
    plot.innerHTML = svg + '<div class="sk-tip" hidden></div>';

    var hit = plot.querySelector(".sk-hit"), xh = plot.querySelector(".sk-xh"), tip = plot.querySelector(".sk-tip");
    var show = function (e) {
      var x = e.clientX - plot.getBoundingClientRect().left, best = 0;
      for (var i = 1; i < n; i++) if (Math.abs(xs(i) - x) < Math.abs(xs(best) - x)) best = i;
      var rows = series.map(function (s) { return { p: s.p, v: s.v[best] }; }).filter(function (r) { return r.v != null; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.v - a.v; });
      if (!rows.length) { tip.hidden = true; xh.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"); return; }
      xh.setAttribute("x1", xs(best)); xh.setAttribute("x2", xs(best)); xh.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
      var tf = c.tip || fmt;
      tip.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--sk-muted)">' + fmtD(pts[best].d) + "</div>" +
        rows.map(function (r) { return "<div>" + dot(r.p) + esc(r.p) + "<b>" + tf(r.v, o) + "</b></div>"; }).join("");
      tip.hidden = false;
      var tw = tip.offsetWidth;
      tip.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - tw, xs(best) + (xs(best) > W / 2 ? -tw - 10 : 10))) + "px";
    };
    hit.addEventListener("pointermove", show);
    hit.addEventListener("pointerdown", show);
    hit.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () { tip.hidden = true; xh.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"); });
  }
  if (tabs) {
    tabs.addEventListener("click", function (e) { var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (b) { state.c = b.getAttribute("data-c"); drawChart(); } });
    sel.addEventListener("change", function () { state.o[state.c] = sel.value; drawChart(); });
    var rz; window.addEventListener("resize", function () { clearTimeout(rz); rz = setTimeout(drawChart, 120); });
    drawChart();
  }

  renderPicker();
  applyMe();
  showRoster(me || (rt && rt.getAttribute("data-default")) || PLAYERS[0]);
})();
</script>
```
